jobs.title: (80 -100%) Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Contract Manager

__

The Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist serves as the central hub between ABB's Local Service Organizations (LSOs) across multiple countries and feeder factories supplying UPS spare parts. This role combines strategic demand forecasting with operational support for spare parts sales and service delivery. The primary focus is to ensure accurate demand signal capture, consolidation, and translation into actionable supply plans while supporting end-to-end spare parts management to achieve high-level service quality, operational efficiency, on-time delivery, order growth, and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts for spare parts, consolidating inputs from LSOs and incorporating installed base data, failure rates, service contracts, product lifecycle changes, and new product introductions.
  • Collaborate with supply chain, engineering, product management, manufacturing, and service teams to ensure parts availability, manage supply risks, and support EOL, ECN, lead time, and inventory planning activities.
  • Monitor forecasting and supply performance through KPIs and dashboards, identify demand anomalies, and drive corrective actions to improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and on-time delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement of planning processes, forecasting tools, ERP data quality, e-commerce platforms, and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance with ABB’s HSE and integrity standards.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in spare parts planning, demand forecasting, service operations, or supply chain management.
  • Experience in power electronics, UPS, critical power systems, or industrial equipment is preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., SAP), forecasting tools, Excel/BI solutions, and e-commerce platforms.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to develop and improve forecasting models.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills, with the ability to translate complex inputs into actionable recommendations.
  • Solid knowledge of spare parts strategies, service operations, and process improvement, with a focus on service availability, delivery performance, standardization, and automation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Il Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist funge da hub centrale tra ABB's Local Service Organizations (LSOs) in più paesi e aziende di approvvigionamento. Questo ruolo combina la previsione strategica della domanda con il supporto operativo per le vendite dei pezzi di ricambio e la consegna dei servizi. L'obiettivo principale è quello di garantire l'acquisizione, il consolidamento e la traduzione del segnale di domanda accurate nei piani di fornitura attuabili, supportando la gestione end-to-end dei pezzi di ricambio per ottenere qualità di servizio di alto livello, efficienza operativa, consegna puntuale, crescita dell'ordine e soddisfazione del cliente. Sarete principalmente responsabili per: Sviluppare e mantenere previsioni di domanda rolling per i pezzi di ricambio, consolidare gli input da LSO e incorporare i dati di base installati, i tassi di guasto, i contratti di servizio, i cambiamenti del ciclo di vita del prodotto e le nuove introduzioni del prodotto. < > > Collabora con i team di supply chain, engineering, product management, manufacturing e service per garantire la disponibilità delle parti, gestire i rischi di approvvigionamento e supportare EOL, ECN, lead time e attività di pianificazione dell'inventario. Monitorare le prestazioni di previsione e fornitura attraverso KPI e dashboard, identificare le anomalie della domanda e guidare azioni correttive per migliorare l'accuratezza delle previsioni, i livelli di servizio e la consegna in tempo. Miglioramento continuo dei processi di pianificazione, degli strumenti di previsione, della qualità dei dati ERP, delle piattaforme di e-commerce e delle iniziative di automazione, garantendo al contempo il rispetto degli standard HSE e di integrità di ABB. • Qualifiche per il ruolo: Laurea in Supply Chain, Business, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo. <ι> 5+ anni di esperienza nella pianificazione dei pezzi di ricambio, nella previsione della domanda, nelle operazioni di servizio o nella gestione della supply chain. < / > > > > > > > > L'esperienza in elettronica di potenza, UPS, sistemi di potenza critici, o attrezzature industriali è preferito. <ιι> Proficienza con sistemi ERP (ad esempio, SAP), strumenti di previsione, soluzioni Excel/BI e piattaforme di e-commerce. <ι> Fluent English; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. < / > > > > > > > > Forte mentalità analitica e data-driven con la capacità di sviluppare e migliorare modelli di previsione. < / > > > > > > > > Ottima gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di comunicazione interculturale, con la capacità di tradurre input complessi in raccomandazioni attuabili. < / > > > > > > > > Conoscenza solida delle strategie dei pezzi di ricambio, delle operazioni di servizio e del miglioramento dei processi, con particolare attenzione alla disponibilità dei servizi, alle prestazioni di consegna, alla standardizzazione e all'automazione. Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Questo è il motivo per cui accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Contract Manager

Der Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist dient als zentraler Knotenpunkt zwischen ABBs lokalen Serviceorganisationen (LSOs) in mehreren Ländern und Feeder Factorys, die USV-Ersatzteile liefern. Diese Rolle kombiniert strategische Nachfrageprognosen mit operativer Unterstützung für den Verkauf und die Servicelieferung von Ersatzteilen. Das Hauptaugenmerk liegt auf der Gewährleistung einer genauen Erfassung, Konsolidierung und Übersetzung von Bedarfssignalen in umsetzbare Versorgungspläne, während das End-to-End-Ersatzteilmanagement unterstützt wird, um eine hohe Servicequalität, Betriebseffizienz, pünktliche Lieferung, Auftragswachstum und Kundenzufriedenheit zu erreichen.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Entwicklung und Pflege von rollenden Bedarfsprognosen für Ersatzteile, Konsolidierung der Inputs von LSOs und Einbeziehung installierter Basisdaten, Ausfallraten, Serviceverträge, Produktlebenszyklusänderungen und Einführung neuer Produkte.
  • Arbeiten Sie mit Supply Chain-, Engineering-, Produktmanagement-, Fertigungs- und Serviceteams zusammen, um die Verfügbarkeit von Teilen sicherzustellen, Versorgungsrisiken zu managen und EOL-, ECN-, Vorlaufzeit- und Lagerplanungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.
  • Überwachen Sie die Prognose- und Versorgungsleistung durch KPIs und Dashboards, identifizieren Sie Nachfrageanomalien und steuern Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Prognosegenauigkeit, des Serviceniveaus und der pünktlichen Lieferung an.
  • Steigende Verbesserung von Planungsprozessen, Prognosetools, ERP-Datenqualität, E-Commerce-Plattformen und Automatisierungsinitiativen bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der HSE- und Integritätsstandards von ABB.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Ersatzteilplanung, Bedarfsprognose, Servicebetrieb oder Supply Chain Management.
  • Erfahrung in Leistungselektronik, USV, kritischen Stromversorgungssystemen oder Industriegeräten wird bevorzugt.
  • Kompetenz mit ERP-Systemen (z.B. SAP), Prognosetools, Excel/BI-Lösungen und E-Commerce-Plattformen.
  • Fluent English; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
  • Starke analytische und datengesteuerte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Prognosemodelle zu entwickeln und zu verbessern.
  • Ausgezeichnetes Stakeholder-Management und interkulturelle Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Inputs in umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu übersetzen.
  • Fundiertes Wissen über Ersatzteilstrategien, Serviceoperationen und Prozessverbesserungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Serviceverfügbarkeit, Lieferleistung, Standardisierung und Automatisierung.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des contrats de services

Le spécialiste mondial de la prévision des pièces de rechange sert de centre central entre les organismes de services locaux (OSL) d'ABB dans plusieurs pays et les usines d'alimentation fournissant des pièces de rechange UPS. Ce rôle combine la prévision stratégique de la demande et le soutien opérationnel pour la vente de pièces de rechange et la prestation de services. L'objectif principal est d'assurer la saisie exacte du signal de demande, la consolidation et la traduction en plans d'approvisionnement réalisables tout en appuyant la gestion des pièces de rechange de bout en bout afin d'atteindre la qualité du service de haut niveau, l'efficacité opérationnelle, la livraison à temps, la croissance des commandes et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride #LI-hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Élaborer et tenir à jour des prévisions de la demande de pièces de rechange, regrouper les intrants des ASL et intégrer les données de base installées, les taux de défaillance, les contrats de service, les changements du cycle de vie des produits et les nouvelles introductions de produits. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Collaborer avec les équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'ingénierie, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication et des services afin d'assurer la disponibilité des pièces, de gérer les risques d'approvisionnement et d'appuyer les activités de planification des stocks, des délais et des délais de livraison. Surveiller le rendement des prévisions et de l'offre au moyen des ICR et des tableaux de bord, cerner les anomalies de la demande et prendre des mesures correctives pour améliorer l'exactitude des prévisions, les niveaux de service et la livraison à temps.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus de planification, des outils de prévision, de la qualité des données du PGI, des plateformes de commerce électronique et des initiatives d'automatisation tout en assurant la conformité aux normes d'ESH et d'intégrité de l'ABB.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Baccalauréat en chaîne d'approvisionnement, affaires, génie, ou un domaine connexe.
  • 5+ ans d'expérience dans la planification des pièces de rechange, la prévision de la demande, les opérations de service ou la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
  • L'expérience en électronique de puissance, en UPS, en systèmes d'alimentation critiques ou en équipement industriel est privilégiée.
  • Profiabilité avec les systèmes ERP (p. ex. SAP), les outils de prévision, les solutions Excel/BI et les plateformes de commerce électronique.
  • Fluent English; d'autres langues européennes sont un avantage.
  • Un état d'esprit analytique et fondé sur les données, capable de développer et d'améliorer les modèles de prévision.
  • Excellente gestion des intervenants et excellente communication interculturelle, avec la capacité de traduire des apports complexes en recommandations concrètes.
  • Connaissance approfondie des stratégies en matière de pièces de rechange, des opérations de service et de l'amélioration des processus, en mettant l'accent sur la disponibilité des services, la prestation des services, la normalisation et l'automatisation.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: NewGen Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Director NewGen PA

__

Role overview:

Leads the Tier 2 Architecture end-to-end Business Solution Design and coordinates development and implementation at the multinational, regional, or global function level, using ABB and/or third-party resources. Leads project execution in accordance with company procedures, relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, project objectives, applicable quality standards, safety requirements, and cost and scheduling targets. Applies project management processes as applicable.

Core responsibilities:

Project Leadership

  • Leads the team allocated to the project, defines the main guidelines, allocates project tasks, and motivates and monitors internal and/or external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones.

  • Coaches, develops, and provides feedback to individuals allocated to managed projects. Provides input to the NewGen Resource Manager to support short-term and longer-term development planning for ABB employees.

Instructions and guidelines:

  • Ensures projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with standard ABB internal directives and procedures, as described in the NewGen PMO Handbook. The project is governed under the ABB Gate Model.

Budget, sales, and operations planning:

  • Keeps up to date and informed about any changes in strategy and is consulted regarding any activities or other projects that have, or might have, a major impact on the project.

  • Develops and gains approval for a business case defining the value proposition of the project.

Project execution and control:

  • Develops a project charter and a project plan (within MS Project) describing how the project will be executed, for communication to project team members and key stakeholders, approval, and as the basis for execution.

  • Organizes, monitors, and controls activities to ensure the effective achievement of planned stage gates and efficient utilization of available resources.

  • Monitors and controls project costs and financials. Identifies, contains, and reduces risks and ensures that all opportunities are captured and acted upon.

  • Formalizes acceptance of the project and concludes all project activities. Prepares handover documentation and training.

  • Manage consultancy partners and solution integrators

  • Plans and tracks all project activities, establishes scheduling risks and opportunities, and delivers projects on time according to commitments.

Stakeholder relations:

  • Serves as the key contact for project stakeholders and an escalation point for project issues.

  • Communicates appropriate information to stakeholders in a timely and effective manner to achieve the desired understanding and support.

  • Develops dedicated stakeholder management and change management plans and applies best practices in change management.

People leadership and development:

  • Develops and manages team members through formal and informal mentoring and coaching.

  • Ensures, in collaboration with the NewGen Resource Manager, appropriate qualification levels of the selected team members.

  • Leads project team members to achieve project requirements, deliver agreed deliverables, and meet the committed project result.

Document management:

  • In collaboration with the NewGen PMO, identifies and plans all document deliverables required by the contractual scope of work and incorporates this plan into the overall project plan/schedule.

  • Tracks document progress and follows up on overdue comments from the NewGen PMO and Gate Assessors.

Key requirements:

  • +15 years of experience in leading the execution of internal strategic business projects at multinational, regional, or global function level, using internal and/or third-party resources.

  • Proven project management practice and experience.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to work in international teams.

  • Certification: PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., CSM, SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified according to 2YAD100055 IS Function Standard_IS Project Manager Certification.

We are open to applications from all qualified candidates. However, from a collaboration perspective, we would preferably consider candidates who are already based in Europe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Fulfillment Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for

  • End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines.

  • Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships.

  • Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity.

  • Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management.

  • Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian.

  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting.

  • Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Fulfillment Lead

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung
Steigen Sie sich ABB an und werden Sie ein wichtiger Teil unserer Lieferkette, um den nahtlosen Materialfluss von unseren globalen Lieferanten zu unseren Produktionslinien zu gewährleisten. In dieser kritischen Rolle sind Sie der zentrale Ansprechpartner für Einkauf und Fulfillment, wo Ihre Planungs- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten sich direkt auf unsere Fähigkeit auswirken, unseren Kunden jederzeit und pünktlich hochwertige Produkte zu liefern.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-Hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für

  • End-to-End Order Management: Verwalten Sie den gesamten Einkaufslebenszyklus innerhalb von SAP, von der Erstellung und Freigabe von Bestellungen bis hin zur aktiven Überwachung und Beschleunigung, um sie an die Produktionspläne und Lieferfristen der Kunden anzupassen.

  • Supplier Performance & Partnership: Steigern Sie die Exzellenz der Lieferanten, indem Sie wichtige Leistungsindikatoren wie pünktliche Lieferung, Qualität und Durchlaufzeiten überwachen. Sie führen Leistungsüberprüfungen durch und lösen proaktiv Probleme, um unsere Lieferkettenpartnerschaften zu stärken.

  • Logistikkoordination & Problemlösung: Beaufsichtigen Sie den Inbound-Logistikprozess, einschließlich der Fracht- und Zollabfertigung. Sie sind der Ansprechpartner für dringende Liefersituationen und die Verwaltung von Nichtkonformitätsberichten, um die operative Kontinuität zu gewährleisten.

  • Datenanalyse & Prozessverbesserung: Erkennen Sie proaktiv Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung unseres Fulfillment-Prozesses, indem Sie Auftragsrückstände analysieren, Ursachen für Verzögerungen identifizieren und effektive Wiederherstellungspläne implementieren. Sie überwachen und gewährleisten die Integrität der Daten, die über EDI-Systeme von Lieferanten ausgetauscht werden.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Ein Abschluss oder Diplom in einem technischen Bereich, Prozessmanagement oder Supply Chain Management.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Fertigungs- oder Industrieumgebung.

  • Starke, praktische Kenntnisse von SAP sind für diese Rolle unerlässlich.

  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit fließender Englisch- und Italienischkenntnissen.

  • Eine proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu verwalten.

Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Project Operations Manager

__

Take your next career step at ABB with a team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

In this role, you will lead a team of eight Project Managers and oversee a diverse portfolio of customer projects within ABB's Motion Traction division in Turgi, Switzerland. You will drive project execution and operational excellence by setting clear priorities, providing guidance and mentorship, fostering collaboration, and ensuring the successful delivery of projects in line with quality, schedule, and financial objectives.

The work model is hybrid.

• Your responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the Project Management team, setting performance expectations, coaching and mentoring team members, fostering engagement, and promoting a culture aligned with ABB's values and people-focused strategies.

  • Ensure successful delivery of customer projects, driving on-time, high-quality, and cost-effective execution while supporting bid activities, managing risks, and maintaining strong customer focus and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Drive project management excellence and continuous improvement, establishing effective methodologies, processes, governance frameworks, and best practices to strengthen project execution capabilities across the organization.

  • Monitor business performance and resource effectiveness, overseeing KPIs, portfolio performance, operational improvements, and cross-functional collaboration with supply chain and other stakeholders to achieve contractual, quality, and financial objectives.

• Your profile:

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience managing complex projects, including scope, budget, schedule, and supplier/subcontractor performance.

  • Previous experience leading a team of Project Managers is highly desirable.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Fluency in German and English is required; additional language skills are considered an asset.

More about us

Diese Position berichtet an:

Global Project Operations Manager

Machen Sie Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt bei ABB mit einem Team, das die Transformation von Gesellschaft und Industrie vorantreibt, um eine produktivere und nachhaltigere Zukunft zu erreichen.

In dieser Funktion leiten Sie ein Team von acht Projektmanagern und betreuen ein vielfältiges Portfolio von Kundenprojekten innerhalb der ABB Motion Traction Division in Turgi, Schweiz. Sie werden die Projektdurchführung und operative Exzellenz vorantreiben, indem Sie klare Prioritäten setzen, Beratung und Mentoring anbieten, die Zusammenarbeit fördern und die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Projekten gemäß Qualität, Zeitplan und finanziellen Zielen sicherstellen.

Das Arbeitsmodell ist hybrid.

• Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Führen und entwickeln Sie das Projektmanagement-Team, setzen Sie Leistungserwartungen, coachen und betreuen Sie Teammitglieder, fördern Sie Engagement und fördern Sie eine Kultur, die auf die Werte und Strategien von ABB ausgerichtet ist.

  • Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Bereitstellung von Kundenprojekten, einer termingerechten, qualitativ hochwertigen und kostengünstigen Ausführung bei gleichzeitiger Unterstützung von Angebotsaktivitäten, dem Management von Risiken und der Aufrechterhaltung einer starken Kundenorientierung und Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit.

  • Förderung der Exzellenz und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Projektmanagements, Etablierung effektiver Methoden, Prozesse, Governance-Frameworks und Best Practices zur Stärkung der Projektausführungsfähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen.

  • Überwachen Sie die Geschäftsleistung und Ressourceneffizienz, überwachen Sie KPIs, Portfolioleistung, operative Verbesserungen und die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit der Lieferkette und anderen Stakeholdern, um vertragliche, qualitative und finanzielle Ziele zu erreichen.

• Ihr Profil:

  • Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Bereich.

  • 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung im Management komplexer Projekte, einschließlich Umfang, Budget, Zeitplan und Leistung von Lieferanten/Subunternehmern.

  • Vorherige Erfahrung in der Leitung eines Teams von Projektmanagern ist sehr wünschenswert.

  • Exzellente Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Stakeholdermanagement, Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit einer proaktiven und lösungsorientierten Denkweise.

Mehr über uns

ABB Motion, ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Motoren und Antrieben, ist der Kern einer produktiveren und nachhaltigeren Zukunft. Wir innovieren und erweitern die Grenzen der Technologie, um zu energieeffizienten, dekarbonisierenden und kreislauforientierten Lösungen für Kunden, Industrien und Gesellschaften beizutragen. Mit unseren digital aktivierten Antrieben, Motoren und Services unterstützen wir unsere Kunden und Partner dabei, mehr Leistung, Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit zu erreichen. Um den Industrien der Welt zu helfen, schlanker und sauberer zu werden, liefern wir motorgetriebene Lösungen für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen in allen Industriesegmenten. Aufbauend auf über 140 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Elektroantriebe lernen und verbessern unsere mehr als 22.000 Mitarbeiter in 100 Ländern jeden Tag. go.abb/motion

jobs.title: Lead Facility Management Switzerland (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Real Estate Manager

__

Take your next career step at ABB with a team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

At ABB, we are committed to driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions. Together, we create an environment where individual differences are valued and celebrated.

Do you have extensive experience in Corporate Real Estate and Facility Management within Switzerland?? Would you like to take responsibility for ABB's Facility Management operations across Switzerland and lead a major FM transformation program? Then join our team in Baden as Lead Facility Management Switzerland.

In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for ABB's Facility Management operations across Switzerland, overseeing a nationwide portfolio of approximately 240,000 sqm of office, production, R&D and logistics space across multiple locations. You will oversee the delivery of integrated FM services through external partners, drive operational excellence and cost optimization, and play a key role in shaping the future FM operating model for ABB Switzerland.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Lead Facility Management service delivery across ABB's Swiss portfolio, acting as the primary interface with the integrated FM provider and ensuring contractual compliance, governance, KPI achievement, and service excellence.

  • Drive the completion of ABB's national FM transformation, including finalization of the FM tender, transition planning, and successful mobilization of the new FM partner across all Swiss locations.

  • Optimize operational performance, compliance and cost efficiency, ensuring adherence to regulatory, HSE and ABB standards while delivering continuous improvements in service quality, sustainability and user experience.

  • Support strategic real estate and facilities objectives, leveraging data-driven insights, stakeholder collaboration, and project leadership to enhance portfolio performance and deliver facility investments.

Your Background

  • Bachelor or Master's degree in Facility Management, Real Estate, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.

  • Approximately 10 years of experience in Corporate Real Estate and/or Corporate Facility Management within Switzerland, preferably within a large multi-site organization.

  • Proven experience managing outsourced FM contracts, external service providers, and integrated FM service delivery models.

  • Experience leading FM transformation, outsourcing, mobilization, or transition projects, with strong project management skills and the ability to drive complex cross-functional initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of operational Facility Management, contract management, performance monitoring, budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels; proactive, customer-focused, and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Fluency in German and English is required; experience driving digital transformation initiatives in Facility Management, including AI, smart buildings, predictive maintenance, workflow automation, and advanced analytics, is a strong advantage.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Facility Management at ABB Switzerland. Beyond managing a significant real estate portfolio, you will lead the transition to a new integrated FM delivery model and establish the foundation for long-term operational excellence across the country.

More about us

Our mission in Real Estate (RE) is to enable ABB businesses to perform at their best through a global real estate management that covers the full end-to-end lifecycle from site selection, management and maintenance to site termination. We have a passion for operational excellence and make every effort to create value for ABB businesses. Our efforts grow out of a commitment to provide healthy and engaging work environments, improve energy efficiency and sustainability and optimize space efficiency for all our buildings in more than 100 countries all over the world. We value people from different backgrounds.

Could this be your story?

Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

The recruiting process is led by Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Cette position se rapporte à:

Real Estate Manager

Faites votre prochaine étape de carrière à ABB avec une équipe qui stimule la transformation de la société et de l'industrie afin d'atteindre un avenir plus productif et durable.

À ABB, nous nous engageons à stimuler la diversité et l'inclusion dans toutes les dimensions. Ensemble, nous créons un environnement dans lequel les différences individuelles sont valorisées et célébrées.

Avez-vous une vaste expérience en gestion des biens immobiliers et des installations en Suisse?? Ensuite, joignez-vous à notre équipe de Baden comme Gestion des installations en Suisse.

Dans ce rôle clé de leadership, vous serez responsable des opérations de gestion des installations en Suisse, en supervisant un portefeuille national d'environ 240 000 m2 de bureaux, de production, de R-D et d'espace logistique dans plusieurs endroits. Vous superviserez la prestation de services de FM intégrés par l'entremise de partenaires externes, stimulerez l'excellence opérationnelle et l'optimisation des coûts, et jouerez un rôle clé dans l'élaboration du futur modèle d'exploitation de FM pour ABB Suisse.

Votre • Gestion de l'installation dans l'ensemble du portefeuille suisse d'ABB, agissant en tant qu'interface principale avec le fournisseur de FM intégré et assurant la conformité contractuelle, la gouvernance, la réalisation de l'ICK et l'excellence du service.

  • Mettre en oeuvre la transformation de la FM nationale d'ABB, y compris la finalisation de l'appel d'offres sur la FM, la planification de la transition et la mobilisation réussie du nouveau partenaire de la FM dans tous les sites suisses.

  • Mettre en oeuvre les objectifs de la gestion de l'immobilier et des installations stratégiques, en assurant le respect des normes réglementaires, de l'ESH et de l'ABB tout en améliorant continuellement la qualité des services, la durabilité et l'expérience des utilisateurs.

    Expérience éprouvée de la gestion des contrats de FM externalisés, des fournisseurs de services externes et des modèles intégrés de prestation de services de FM.

  • Expérience menant des projets de transformation, d'externalisation, de mobilisation ou de transition, avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité de conduire des initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes.

  • Mieux comprendre la gestion opérationnelle des installations, la gestion des contrats, la surveillance du rendement, la budgétisation, les prévisions et l'optimisation des coûts.

  • Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité d'influencer et de collaborer efficacement à tous les niveaux organisationnels; esprit proactif, axé sur le client et axé sur les solutions.

  • La souplesse en allemand et en anglais est requise; l'expérience menant des initiatives de transformation numérique dans la gestion des installations, y compris l'IA, les bâtiments intelligents, la maintenance prédictive, l'automatisation des flux de travail et l'analyse avancée est un avantage important.

    Plus d'information sur nous

Nous sommes passionnés par l'excellence opérationnelle et faisons tout notre possible pour créer de la valeur pour les entreprises ABB. Nos efforts s'appuient sur l'engagement de fournir des environnements de travail sains et engageants, d'améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et la durabilité et d'optimiser l'efficacité spatiale de tous nos bâtiments dans plus de 100 pays du monde. jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manufacturing Unit Manager

__

We're seeking a strategic Operations Leader to manage cross-functional coordination and operational excellence across our Manufacturing Unit. You'll develop Integrated Production Unit leaders, facilitate collaboration between Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and HR functions, and lead transformation initiatives that remove barriers to execution. Your main focus will be on structuring and executing ramp-up plan (3X actual volume), embracing the operations scope end-to-end (from supply readiness to material availability and production readiness).

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the Smart Power division in Quartino.

Your main responsibilities will be:

· Elevate Leadership & Support Alignment: Coach and develop IPU Leaders, encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across the organization, improve problem-solving and team engagement practices, and guide the maturity and evolution of the IPU model while ensuring seamless alignment of priorities and action plans

· Lead Transformation & Build for the Future: Coordinate strategic manufacturing projects and transformation initiatives, with focus on volume ramp-up on supply chain, production workers, office workers and test infrastructure, contributing to the long-term development of the operations

· Bridge Functions & Support Operational Excellence: Serve as the primary facilitator across Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, Agile units (R&D/PM), and HR, standardizing and deploying best practices while ensuring alignment on priorities, resources, and execution plans; resolve cross-functional barriers and escalations, and promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous learning

· Measure Success Through Tangible Impact: Remove cross-functional barriers to execution, improve value stream efficiency and operational stability, increase collaboration and alignment across IPUs and support functions, and build greater maturity and autonomy among IPU Leaders

What we are looking for:

· Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering; +10 years of progressive experience as Operations Manager (or similar role e.g. Planning & fulfillment manager)

· Demonstrated ability to structure & implement production ramp up in less than 12 months to triple production volumes, ensuring strong governance across complex organizations and cross-functional teams (planning, procurement, quality, production, engineering)

· Deep knowledge (360° view) of operations processes (from engineering to material availability, to capacity planning & order execution), with a commitment to delivering operational excellence at scale

· Skilled in leading cross-functional projects, overseeing quality assurance initiatives, and maintaining a clear focus on customer satisfaction

· Deep understanding of supply chain and bottleneck to ramp-up production, as well as proven experience to mitigate risks (eg- double sourcing, strategic agreement, etc.)

· Solid analytical skills with the ability to translate data and reporting insights into actionable improvements that enhance performance and business outcomes

· Fluent in Italian (written and spoken); proficiency in English is an advantage

• What we offer:

· Employee Share Plan (ESAP)

· Remote work & flexible work schedules

· Attractive Parental Leave

· Personal Development

More about us:
At ABB Smart Power we know that solutions take passion to succeed and that it takes real innovation for a technology to fit into their worlds and solve their problems.

This will only be possible if we are passionate and inclusive. One cannot work without the other. Our customers need us all to come together, with a passion to make great things happen

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Order Handling Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:
As an Order Management Specialist, you serve as the primary point of contact for customers and business partners regarding UPS Systems within the Electrification/ Power Protection business area, based in Baden, Switzerland.

Reporting to the Head of Project management & Engineering, you play a key role in supporting the sales-& project management team by leveraging your customer service & project execution expertise to manage and respond to customer inquiries and project needs efficiently and professionally.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Processes orders by coordinating with Sales, Project and other internal teams to ensure that customers receive accurate and timely delivery of products
  • Organize project material logistics with factory, suppliers and customers
  • Monitor order production status, delivery schedules, and proactively manage delays or escalations to maintain customer satisfaction
  • Handle invoicing and customer account setup in accordance with internal guidelines and project team input
  • Supports the sales/ project team in execution phase by resolving customer issues and ensuring effective and efficient customer and internal stakeholders communication


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed commercial apprenticeship; further education at higher vocational level (HF) is an advantage
  • Several years of professional experience in order processing or a similar role
  • Agile and proactive mindset with a proven ability to take ownership of customer issues
  • Solid knowledge and experience in customer service
  • Confident user of SAP
  • Experience in EU-Export Process is an advantage
  • Strong team player with a solution-oriented and independent working style, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Fluent in German and French; Italian is a plus and English is welcome


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:
As an Order Management Specialist, you serve as the primary point of contact for customers and business partners regarding UPS Systems within the Electrification/ Power Protection business area, based in Baden, Switzerland.

Reporting to the Head of Project management & Engineering, you play a key role in supporting the sales-& project management team by leveraging your customer service & project execution expertise to manage and respond to customer inquiries and project needs efficiently and professionally.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Processes orders by coordinating with Sales, Project and other internal teams to ensure that customers receive accurate and timely delivery of products
  • Organize project material logistics with factory, suppliers and customers
  • Monitor order production status, delivery schedules, and proactively manage delays or escalations to maintain customer satisfaction
  • Handle invoicing and customer account setup in accordance with internal guidelines and project team input
  • Supports the sales/ project team in execution phase by resolving customer issues and ensuring effective and efficient customer and internal stakeholders communication


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed commercial apprenticeship; further education at higher vocational level (HF) is an advantage
  • Several years of professional experience in order processing or a similar role
  • Agile and proactive mindset with a proven ability to take ownership of customer issues
  • Solid knowledge and experience in customer service
  • Confident user of SAP
  • Experience in EU-Export Process is an advantage
  • Strong team player with a solution-oriented and independent working style, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Fluent in German and French; Italian is a plus and English is welcome


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Project Operations Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten:
Als Order Management Specialist sind Sie primärer Ansprechpartner für Kunden und Geschäftspartner rund um UPS Systems im Geschäftsbereich Electrification/Power Protection mit Sitz in Baden, Schweiz.

Bei der Berichterstattung an den Head of Project Management & Engineering spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Unterstützung des Vertriebs- und Projektmanagementteams, indem Sie Ihre Expertise im Bereich Kundenservice und Projektdurchführung nutzen, um Kundenanfragen und Projektanforderungen effizient und professionell zu verwalten und zu beantworten.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Verarbeitet Aufträge durch Koordination mit Sales, Project und anderen internen Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass die Kunden eine genaue und rechtzeitige Lieferung der Produkte erhalten
  • Organisieren Sie die Projektmateriallogistik mit Fabrik, Lieferanten und Kunden
  • Überwachen Sie den Produktionsstatus der Bestellung, Lieferpläne und verwalten Sie proaktiv Verzögerungen oder Eskalationen, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten
  • Handhabung von Rechnungsstellung und Einrichtung von Kundenkonten gemäß internen Richtlinien und Projektteameingaben
  • Unterstützt das Vertriebs-/Projektteam in der Ausführungsphase, indem es Kundenprobleme löst und eine effektive und effiziente Kommunikation zwischen Kunden und internen Stakeholdern gewährleistet


• Qualifikationen für die Stelle:

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung; Weiterbildung auf höherem Berufsniveau (HF) ist von Vorteil
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Auftragsverarbeitung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle
  • Agiles und proaktives Mindset mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, sich um Kundenthemen zu kümmern
  • Festes Wissen und Erfahrung im Kundenservice
    • Selbstbewusster Nutzer von SAP
  • Erfahrung im EU-Exportprozess ist ein Vorteil
  • Starker Teamplayer mit einem lösungsorientierten und unabhängigen Arbeitsstil kombiniert mit exzellenten verbalen und schriftlichen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Fluent in Deutsch und Französisch; Italienisch ist ein Plus und Englisch ist willkommen


Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter,
Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, Energie zu sparen und CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren.

Die Rekrutierung wird von Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

geleitet. Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des opérations de projet

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités:
En tant que spécialiste de la gestion des commandes, vous êtes le principal point de contact pour les clients et les partenaires commerciaux concernant UPS Systems dans le secteur d'activité Electrification/Protection de l'alimentation, basé à Baden, en Suisse.

Sous l'autorité du chef de la gestion de projet et de l'ingénierie, vous jouez un rôle clé en appuyant l'équipe de gestion de projet et de vente en tirant parti de votre expertise en matière de service à la clientèle et d'exécution de projet pour gérer et répondre efficacement et professionnellement aux demandes et aux besoins des clients.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Procéder aux commandes en coordonnant avec les ventes, le projet et d'autres équipes internes pour s'assurer que les clients reçoivent la livraison exacte et en temps opportun des produits
  • Organiser la logistique du matériel du projet avec l'usine, les fournisseurs et les clients
  • Surveiller l'état de la production des commandes, les calendriers de livraison et gérer proactivement les retards ou les escalades pour maintenir la satisfaction de la clientèle
  • Gérer la facturation et la configuration du compte client conformément aux lignes directrices internes et à l'entrée de l'équipe de projet
  • Soutient l'équipe de vente/projet en phase d'exécution en résolvant les problèmes des clients et en assurant une communication efficace et efficiente entre les clients et les intervenants internes


• Qualifications pour le rôle:

  • Enseignement professionnel complet; l'enseignement supérieur professionnel (HF) est un avantage
  • Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le traitement des commandes ou un rôle semblable
  • Un état d'esprit agile et proactif avec une capacité éprouvée de prendre en charge les problèmes des clients
  • Solide connaissances et expérience en matière de service à la clientèle
  • Confident utilisateur de SAP
  • L'expérience dans le processus d'exportation de l'UE est un avantage
  • Un joueur de l'équipe de haut niveau ayant un style de travail indépendant et axé sur la solution, associé à d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite
  • Fluent en allemand et en français; l'italien est un plus et l'anglais est le bienvenu


Plus sur nous

ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend les disjoncteurs industriels, les systèmes à basse tension, les applications de démarrage de moteurs et les dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. La division ABB AptitudeTM Energy Manager fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.

Le recrutement est dirigé par Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Maintenance Team Leader

__

At ABB, we value individual differences, both as individuals and as a team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, with around 270 employees, is a leading developer, manufacturer, and international supplier of low-voltage protection devices and the CMS current monitoring system. A customer-focused mindset, short decision-making paths, and a high degree of personal responsibility are key to strengthening our market position.

To strengthen our motivated team in Schaffhausen, we are looking for an engaged Service Technician to join us as soon as possible. Do you enjoy solving technical problems and helping to ensure smooth operations in a stable, growing, and modern manufacturing environment?


We look forward to receiving your application.


Your role and responsibilities


• Troubleshoot and resolve issues on highly automated production equipment (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• Perform preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

• Collaborate closely with manufacturing teams, Production Engineering, and external service providers to ensure smooth production operations

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment, including Lean Management activities


• Qualifications for the role


• Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, Production Technician, Electrician, or in a comparable technical field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in industrial automation, ideally within a manufacturing environment

• Experience troubleshooting and repairing complex production and assembly systems (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• NIV13 or NIV15 electrical installation certification is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it with ABB support

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, combined with a proactive and independent working style

• Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP, as well as excellent German language skills (written and spoken); English language skills are an advantage

• Willingness to work in a three-shift operation, including on-call duty after the onboarding period


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

• Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

• Training, development, and career growth opportunities

• Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

• REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

• 27 to 30 days of annual leave, plus paid company holidays between Christmas and New Year


More about us


Our Schaffhausen site has been growing steadily for many years.

Our diverse production environment offers exciting and varied areas of responsibility, ranging from proven, long-established technologies to state-of-the-art system solutions. Our machine park is continuously expanding with new equipment that is aligned with industry benchmarks.

ABB Smart Buildings digitizes commercial, industrial, and residential buildings to deliver the highest levels of comfort, efficiency, safety, and security. Through safe, intelligent, and sustainable electrification solutions, services, and products, we are improving quality of life in the buildings of the future.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Pour renforcer notre position sur le marché, il est essentiel de disposer d'un état d'esprit axé sur le client, de courtes voies de décision et d'un degré élevé de responsabilité personnelle.

Pour renforcer notre équipe motivée à Schaffhausen, nous sommes à la recherche d'un technicien de service engagé pour nous rejoindre dès que possible. Ayez-vous plaisir à résoudre des problèmes techniques et à vous assurer que vos activités se déroulent dans un environnement de fabrication stable, en pleine croissance et moderne?


Nous attendons avec impatience de recevoir votre demande.


Votre rôle et vos responsabilités


• Dépanner et résoudre des problèmes liés à l'équipement de production hautement automatisé (mécanique, électrique et pneumatique)

• Effectuer l'entretien préventif et l'entretien de l'équipement de production

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de fabrication, le génie de la production et les fournisseurs de services externes afin d'assurer une production harmonieuse

• Contribuer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'environnement de production, y compris les activités de gestion du levier

• Qualifications pour le rôle


• Formation professionnelle terminée en tant que technicien en automatisation, technicien en mécatronique, technicien en mécanique, technicien en production, électricien ou dans un domaine technique comparable

• Un minimum de 10 ans d'expérience en automatisation industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement de fabrication

• Expérience du dépannage et de la réparation de systèmes complexes de production et d'assemblage (mécaniques, électriques et pneumatiques)

• La certification d'installation électrique NIV13 ou NIV15 est un avantage, ou une volonté d'obtenir celle-ci avec le soutien de l'ABB

• Forte aptitude au travail d'équipe et à la communication, combinée à un style de travail proactif et indépendant

• Connaissances de base du bureau de la MS et du SAP, ainsi qu'à d'excellentes compétences en langue allemande (écrite et parlée); les compétences en anglais sont un avantage

• La volonté de travailler en trois équipes, y • Nous offrons à nos employés une gamme d'avantages intéressants, y compris :

• Trousse de rémunération attrayante, y compris les primes, le salaire de 13e mois et le Programme d'acquisition de parts d'employés (PAES)

• Possibilités de formation, de perfectionnement et de croissance de carrière

• Contributions aux membres du gymnase et aux services médicaux (IFA)

• Bons et rabais REKA par l'entremise de Swibeco

• De 27 à 30 jours de congé annuel, plus les congés payés de l'entreprise entre Noël et le Nouvel An


Plus au sujet de nous


Notre site de Schaffhausen connaît une croissance constante depuis de nombreuses années.

Notre environnement de production diversifié offre des domaines de responsabilité passionnants et variés, allant de technologies éprouvées et établies à des solutions de systèmes de pointe. Notre parc de machines est en expansion continue avec de nouveaux équipements qui sont alignés sur les repères de l'industrie.

ABB Smart Buildings numérise les bâtiments commerciaux, industriels et résidentiels pour offrir les plus hauts niveaux de confort, d'efficacité, de sûreté et de sécurité. Grâce à des solutions, des services et des produits d'électrification sûrs, intelligents et durables, nous améliorons la qualité de vie dans les bâtiments du futur.


Le processus de recrutement est géré par la Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Lead Administrative Services & Site Communications

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience through a one-year placement starting on August 1, 2027. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing your personal and professional development opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

Administrative Services & Communication MOHP – ABB, Untersiggenthal

The position is based in Untersiggenthal, near Baden.

Your main responsibility will be to support employees from various departments in ensuring the smooth running of their daily work, as well as managing projects responsibly.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Onboarding and offboarding of new employees; Procurement of work materials (IT, hardware, software, office equipment, etc.).

  • Technical support for all IT related questions; Invoice processing using SAP based tools.

  • Event planning for employees and important (including international) customers; Management of promotional items in collaboration with our advertising agency.

  • Collaboration on improving internal workflows; Internal communication on current topics using various tools.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Student from a WMS or HMS

  • Knowledge of Office 365, especially PowerPoint and SharePoint

  • Willingness to work with additional Office tools

  • Fluent in German with good English skills

  • High level of engagement and on‑site presence

  • Solution‑oriented and self-managed working style

  • Team spirit and a motivated and collaborative mindset

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Team Lead Administrative Services & Site Communications

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB's Motion High Power Division in Switzerland with a broad range of administrative and organizational tasks. You will be part of a newly formed assistant team and report to the Teamlead Administrative Services & Site Communication.

Together with your colleagues, you will support local employees and leaders, contribute to smooth day-to-day operations and help ensure that administrative processes run efficiently and professionally. This role offers a unique combination of teamwork, responsibility and variety, with close interaction across different functions and departments. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes ownership, and likes finding practical solutions in a dynamic business environment.

This position supports the Motion, High Power Division in Untersiggenthal, Canton Aargau.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Provide administrative and organizational support to executives and employees, including coordination of calendars, travel arrangements, and meetings.

  • Contribute to projects, events, and internal communications while ensuring a professional visitor experience and fostering a positive workplace environment.

  • Manage administrative processes such as procurement, invoicing, and onboarding/offboarding activities, while continuously improving workflows and tools.

  • Collaborate closely with the administrative support team and mentor apprentices, helping to promote a positive learning and working culture.


Our team dynamics
You will join a newly established assistant team and help shape how we collaborate and support the organization.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed commercial apprenticeship or comparable qualification.

  • Several years of experience in an administrative, assistant or coordination role.

  • Strong organizational and planning skills.

  • Service-oriented and proactive approach.

  • Ability to prioritize and remain calm in a changing environment.

  • A friendly and approachable demeanor, along with a dynamic and enthusiastic approach to tasks

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.

Work model: Field-based

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with customers on-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges

  • Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified

  • Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition

  • Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required

Our team

You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.

Your qualifications

  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage

  • Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment

  • Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork

  • Fluent German and basic English skills for professional communication with customers

  • Willingness to travel, participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Midlands / Bern region

  • Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities

  • Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts

  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
