jobs.title: Quality Specialist (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.

  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.

  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).



• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience

  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)

  • Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)

  • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)

  • Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)

  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications



Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Eco bonus



More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.

  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.

  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).



• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience

  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)

  • Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)

  • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)

  • Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)

  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications



Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Eco bonus



More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Connaissance des dessins techniques, GD&T, et des spécifications des matériaux et des composants

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

ABB Electrification – Distribution Solutions develops technologies and solutions for safer, more reliable, and more sustainable electrical networks.

You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving the commercial development of ABB's Medium Voltage products, solutions, and services across French-speaking Switzerland.

You will contribute to the sustainable growth, profitability, and strengthening of ABB's market presence within your territory.

You will manage your territory with a high degree of commercial autonomy and support opportunities from needs identification through to contract closing, working closely with various ABB teams.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will report to the Head of Sales Utilities & Industries Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and implement the sales strategy for ABB's Medium Voltage portfolio across French-speaking Switzerland, focusing on utilities, EPCs, system integrators, industrial customers, and other key market players.

  • Expand business within existing accounts while proactively identifying and securing new customers, applications, and growth opportunities through strong relationship management and customer engagement.

  • Manage the entire sales process from lead identification to contract award, including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, proposal strategy, pricing, sales forecasting, and commercial and contractual negotiations, in coordination with relevant legal and risk management functions.

  • Collaborate closely with Tendering, Product Marketing, Project Management, and Service teams to deliver competitive customer solutions, while monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and pricing developments to drive sustainable order, revenue, and profitability growth.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Higher education degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Good knowledge of electrical power networks, particularly distribution networks; experience in the medium-voltage sector is a significant advantage.

  • Experience in B2B sales of technical products, systems, or solutions.

  • Strong customer focus and proven ability to develop long-term business relationships and identify new opportunities.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, self-motivation, and the ability to independently develop and manage a sales territory.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills, along with the ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into compelling customer value propositions.

  • Fluent French and good English skills; German is considered an advantage.


More about us
You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

The recruitment process is led by Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner at ABB.

CVs submitted in English are appreciated.

ABB Electrification – Distribution Solutions développe des technologies et des solutions pour des réseaux électriques plus sûrs, plus fiables et plus durables.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland et contribuerez au développement des activités ABB en Suisse romande, dans un environnement technique, dynamique et fortement orienté client.

Dans cette fonction, vous serez responsable du développement commercial des produits, solutions et services Moyenne Tension d’ABB en Suisse romande.

Vous contribuerez durablement à la croissance, à la profitabilité et au renforcement de la présence d’ABB sur votre territoire.

Vous gérerez votre territoire avec une forte autonomie commerciale et accompagnerez les opportunités de l’identification du besoin jusqu’au closing, en étroite collaboration avec les différentes équipes ABB.

Vous rapporterez au Head of Sales Utilities & Industries Switzerland.

• Vos responsabilités

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie commerciale pour le portefeuille Moyenne Tension d’ABB en Suisse romande, auprès des gestionnaires de réseaux de distribution, des bureaux d’ingénieurs, des entreprises d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement et de construction (EPC), des intégrateurs de systèmes, des clients industriels ainsi que d’autres acteurs clés du marché.

  • Développer les activités auprès des clients existants tout en identifiant et en développant activement de nouveaux clients, applications et opportunités de croissance, grâce à une gestion efficace des relations commerciales et à un engagement fort auprès des clients.

  • Piloter l’ensemble du processus de vente, de l’identification des opportunités jusqu’à la conclusion du contrat, y compris la qualification des opportunités, le positionnement des solutions, la stratégie d’offres, la tarification, les prévisions de ventes ainsi que les négociations commerciales et contractuelles, en coordination avec les équipes juridiques et de gestion des risques concernées.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des offres, du marketing produit, de la gestion de projets et du service afin de proposer des solutions compétitives aux clients. Assurer également une veille active des tendances du marché, des activités de la concurrence et de l’évolution des prix afin de soutenir une croissance durable des commandes, du chiffre d’affaires et de la rentabilité.

Votre parcours

  • Formation supérieure en électrotechnique, énergie ou dans un domaine technique comparable.

  • Bonne connaissance des réseaux électriques, notamment des réseaux de distribution ; une expérience dans le domaine de la moyenne tension constitue un avantage important.

  • Expérience dans la vente B2B de produits, systèmes ou solutions techniques.

  • Forte orientation client et capacité démontrée à développer des relations commerciales durables et de nouvelles opportunités.

  • Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et motivation à développer activement son territoire.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de collaboration, ainsi qu’une aptitude à comprendre des problématiques techniques et à les transformer en propositions de valeur pour les clients.

  • Français courant et bonnes connaissances de l’anglais ; l’allemand constitue un avantage.

​

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

ABB Electrification – Distribution Solutions develops technologies and solutions for safer, more reliable, and more sustainable electrical networks.

You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving the commercial development of ABB's Medium Voltage products, solutions, and services across French-speaking Switzerland.

You will contribute to the sustainable growth, profitability, and strengthening of ABB's market presence within your territory.

You will manage your territory with a high degree of commercial autonomy and support opportunities from needs identification through to contract closing, working closely with various ABB teams.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will report to the Head of Sales Utilities & Industries Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and implement the sales strategy for ABB's Medium Voltage portfolio across French-speaking Switzerland, focusing on utilities, EPCs, system integrators, industrial customers, and other key market players.

  • Expand business within existing accounts while proactively identifying and securing new customers, applications, and growth opportunities through strong relationship management and customer engagement.

  • Manage the entire sales process from lead identification to contract award, including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, proposal strategy, pricing, sales forecasting, and commercial and contractual negotiations, in coordination with relevant legal and risk management functions.

  • Collaborate closely with Tendering, Product Marketing, Project Management, and Service teams to deliver competitive customer solutions, while monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and pricing developments to drive sustainable order, revenue, and profitability growth.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Higher education degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Good knowledge of electrical power networks, particularly distribution networks; experience in the medium-voltage sector is a significant advantage.

  • Experience in B2B sales of technical products, systems, or solutions.

  • Strong customer focus and proven ability to develop long-term business relationships and identify new opportunities.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, self-motivation, and the ability to independently develop and manage a sales territory.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills, along with the ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into compelling customer value propositions.

  • Fluent French and good English skills; German is considered an advantage.


More about us
You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

The recruitment process is led by Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner at ABB.

CVs submitted in English are appreciated.

ABB Electrification – Distribution Solutions développe des technologies et des solutions pour des réseaux électriques plus sûrs, plus fiables et plus durables.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland et contribuerez au développement des activités ABB en Suisse romande, dans un environnement technique, dynamique et fortement orienté client.

Dans cette fonction, vous serez responsable du développement commercial des produits, solutions et services Moyenne Tension d’ABB en Suisse romande.

Vous contribuerez durablement à la croissance, à la profitabilité et au renforcement de la présence d’ABB sur votre territoire.

Vous gérerez votre territoire avec une forte autonomie commerciale et accompagnerez les opportunités de l’identification du besoin jusqu’au closing, en étroite collaboration avec les différentes équipes ABB.

Vous rapporterez au Head of Sales Utilities & Industries Switzerland.

• Vos responsabilités

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie commerciale pour le portefeuille Moyenne Tension d’ABB en Suisse romande, auprès des gestionnaires de réseaux de distribution, des bureaux d’ingénieurs, des entreprises d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement et de construction (EPC), des intégrateurs de systèmes, des clients industriels ainsi que d’autres acteurs clés du marché.

  • Développer les activités auprès des clients existants tout en identifiant et en développant activement de nouveaux clients, applications et opportunités de croissance, grâce à une gestion efficace des relations commerciales et à un engagement fort auprès des clients.

  • Piloter l’ensemble du processus de vente, de l’identification des opportunités jusqu’à la conclusion du contrat, y compris la qualification des opportunités, le positionnement des solutions, la stratégie d’offres, la tarification, les prévisions de ventes ainsi que les négociations commerciales et contractuelles, en coordination avec les équipes juridiques et de gestion des risques concernées.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des offres, du marketing produit, de la gestion de projets et du service afin de proposer des solutions compétitives aux clients. Assurer également une veille active des tendances du marché, des activités de la concurrence et de l’évolution des prix afin de soutenir une croissance durable des commandes, du chiffre d’affaires et de la rentabilité.

Votre parcours

  • Formation supérieure en électrotechnique, énergie ou dans un domaine technique comparable.

  • Bonne connaissance des réseaux électriques, notamment des réseaux de distribution ; une expérience dans le domaine de la moyenne tension constitue un avantage important.

  • Expérience dans la vente B2B de produits, systèmes ou solutions techniques.

  • Forte orientation client et capacité démontrée à développer des relations commerciales durables et de nouvelles opportunités.

  • Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et motivation à développer activement son territoire.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de collaboration, ainsi qu’une aptitude à comprendre des problématiques techniques et à les transformer en propositions de valeur pour les clients.

  • Français courant et bonnes connaissances de l’anglais ; l’allemand constitue un avantage.

​

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Global Supplier Quality Engineer – PCBA&Cables
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Quality & Continuous Imp Manager

__

We are looking for a Global Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) – Commodity PCBA & Cable, who will be responsible for leading the qualification, development, and performance management of a panel of approximately 10–15 global EMS suppliers located across different regions worldwide.

This position plays a key role within the rapidly growing Critical Power business, driven by the strong expansion of the data center market.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid / remote.

Roles and • Responsibilities:

  • Ensures the execution of the supplier qualification process and that the relevant suppliers are fully qualified and remain compliant with the required standards.
  • Leads improvement projects in collaboration with the on-site Supplier team (Supplier Development)
  • Uses supplier quality management tools and systems for collaboration, reporting, monitoring and disposition of quality, delivery, cost, and compliance metrics
  • Ensure consistency in the process/product controls performed on the different parts purchased from different ABB Manufacturing Units/ Local Sales Unit (LSOs).
  • Leads in promptly addressing supply issues related to quality, deliveries, non-compliant products, or project services.
  • Promotes early supplier involvement in product development activities to maximize capture of supplier innovation and drive improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and risk management.

Preferred • Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic or electrical engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in Quality Management roles within a EMS (Electronic Manufacturing Services) Industry
  • Deep product knowledge of IPC Standard. Being an IPC-A-610/IPC-A-620 trainer is considered a plus
  • Proven experience in cross-functional and cross-site Quality management, including RCA methodologies, CAPA processes, and KPI-driven performance management
  • Green Belt of Black belt certifications
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align global teams across different cultures and organizational levels

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role you will have the opportunity to drive high quality life cycle management of critical power equipment: from developing new products and features to maintaining and improving existing solutions. Each day, you will use your skills and technical expertise to generate mechanical design requirements. You will also showcase your expertise by testing and documenting your designs for coordination with other technical teams within AU Critical Power.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power Agile Unit in Quartino, Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Contribute to the mechanical design, development, and documentation of new and enhanced critical power equipment, from concept through release and maintenance.

  • Collaborate across engineering and business functions to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions that meet customer, project, and operational requirements.

  • Participate in design reviews, verification activities, and continuous improvement initiatives, incorporating feedback and driving product optimization.

  • Support prototype development and fabrication, ensuring successful validation, industrialization, and enhancement of products throughout their lifecycle.


Our team dynamics:
You will join a diverse and innovative team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • A University Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 2+ years of experience and knowledge of solid modeling CAD design software (Creo, etc.) required

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills. You are at ease communicating in English

  • Knowledge sheet metal design, detail part drawings, assembly drawings, and design for manufacturing.

  • Experience interpreting and applying electrical safety standards (UL/IEC, etc.). Experience in structural simulation and PLM software is a plus.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:

R&D Team Lead

Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to successful project results in technology, software, product, and/or solution development, as well as associated Intellectual Property (IP). Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the ABB MOTR Traction organization in Untersiggenthal Switzerland. Main stakeholders are the Traction R&D management and System Engineering organization

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design and develop embedded software for real-time and embedded VxWorks and Linux systems.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable products.

  • Architect and maintain DevSecOps pipelines enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and release processes.

  • Implement secure coding practices and drive cybersecurity compliance throughout the software lifecycle.

  • Develop automated testing frameworks and ensure high software quality and reliability.

  • Lead code reviews, technical mentoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Manage software configuration, release management, and lifecycle support activities.

  • Drive the adoption of modern DevSecOps and Secure SDLC best practices across engineering teams.


You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing and international team, where you will be able to thrive.

  • Solid degree in computer science, electrical engineering or electronics

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in embedded real time software engineering, applying modern C/C++ concepts. Python is an advantage

  • You are passionate about agile methodologies in SW engineering applying SCRUM in a SAFe® value creation Framework

This position reports to:

IPU Leader Buy&Sell

__


In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead a team within a Production unit or line to execute production processes, transforming parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely and cost-effective manner. Each day, you will ensure continuous and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings, and quality and safety standards and policies. You will also showcase your expertise by organizing and allocating resources to meet line production targets effectively and efficiently.

This role is contributing to the IPU BUY&SELL in Quartino.

  • Leading and developing a multidisciplinary production and logistics team responsible for spare parts picking, packing and shipping, single-phase UPS order fulfillment, PCBA testing, field returns management, and subassembly production, while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Planning, coordinating, and overseeing daily production, testing, and logistics operations to ensure on-time customer order fulfillment, compliance with service level agreements, and achievement of Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Productivity (SQDCP) objectives.

  • Managing subassembly manufacturing and field return activities, coordinating inspection, testing, rework, and disposition processes with Quality, Engineering, and Service teams to ensure product quality and compliance with manufacturing standards.

You will join a dynamic and collaborative team, where you will be able to thrive.

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably as a Production Supervisor, Team Leader, or Production Coordinator.
  • Proven experience in leading production teams, managing daily operations, and achieving Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Productivity targets.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Good knowledge of SAP.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer – Embedded Firmware (80 - 100%) f/m/d
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__


In this role, you will develop embedded firmware for UPS power supply systems, working across real-time operating systems, microcontroller platforms, hardware interfaces, testing, and cybersecurity compliance. You will help deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable firmware solutions in a global engineering environment.

• Your responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and debug embedded C firmware for UPS power supply systems using FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex and TI microcontroller platforms, including hardware abstraction layers and interfaces such as GPIO, interrupts, timers, and communication protocols.
  • Build and execute automated and integration tests using gTest or similar frameworks, applying best practices for code quality, maintainability, and compliance with standards such as EU CRA and IEC 62443.
  • Collaborate with design, testing, and cybersecurity teams to deliver reliable firmware, and use Git, build systems, and CI/CD practices to support efficient software development and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrate ownership, clear communication, and attention to detail while continuously learning and contributing within an Agile engineering environment.

Your background

  • Degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 3–5 years of embedded systems or firmware development experience.
  • Strong embedded C/C++ skills; experience with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
  • Knowledge of ARM Cortex, TI microcontrollers, FreeRTOS, and embedded communication protocols such as SPI, UART, I2C, RS485, Modbus, or CAN.
  • Hands-on experience with hardware debugging, firmware integration, Git, build systems, and structured software development practices.
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Ethernet/IP, CAN, or IEC 61850, and with HMI panels or HMI design tools.
  • Familiarity with Node.js or IoT communication layers, plus understanding of power electronics and UPS architecture, including battery management, power conversion, and thermal management.
  • Fluent in English and Italian language skills and Agile experience are considered a plus.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader in electrification, delivering smart, connected, and protected power solutions. Our UPS Product Line improves energy efficiency, reliability, and security for critical applications worldwide. We value people from different backgrounds and welcome applications from candidates who want to help shape a more sustainable and resilient future.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Field Service Engineer, you are a key player in our organization and one of our primary ambassadors to our customers. The value of our solutions is also reflected in the quality of their implementation in the field. Whether it involves commissioning, maintenance, or troubleshooting, our specialists are recognized and valued for their technical expertise, professionalism, and interpersonal skills.

The work model for the role is field-based.


This role is contributing to the Motion Service, Local Sales Unit in Morges.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of frequency converters (drives).

  • Fault diagnosis and troubleshooting directly at customer sites.

  • Administrative tasks such as service reports, protocols and technical reports, as well as on-call duty.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Federal Certificate of Proficiency (CFC) in Automation, Automation Assembly, Electronics, Electrical Installation, Electrical Assembly, or equivalent qualification.

  • Advanced Federal Diploma (ES) or University of Applied Sciences degree (HES) is a plus.

  • Experience in the field of power electronics is desired.

  • Excellent command of French; good communication skills in English are required. Knowledge of German is an advantage.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

  • Availability for a field-based role with frequent travel across Switzerland and on-call duty.

  • Good communication skills.

  • Self-reliant, responsible, and customer-oriented personality.

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Company Car

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Operations Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Als Field Service Engineer sind Sie ein wichtiger Akteur in unserer Organisation und einer unserer wichtigsten Botschafter für unsere Kunden. Der Wert unserer Lösungen spiegelt sich auch in der Qualität ihrer Umsetzung vor Ort wider. Ob es sich um die Inbetriebnahme, Wartung oder Fehlersuche handelt, unsere Spezialisten werden für ihre technische Expertise, Professionalität und zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten anerkannt und geschätzt.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist feldbasiert.


Diese Rolle trägt zum Motion Service, Local Sales Unit in Morges bei.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für die Installation, Inbetriebnahme, Wartung und Reparatur von Frequenzumrichtern (Antrieben).

  • Fehlerdiagnose und Fehlerbehebung direkt bei Kunden vor Ort.

  • Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Serviceberichte, Protokolle und technische Berichte sowie Bereitschaftsdienste.

    • • Qualifikationen für die Rolle

    • Federal Certificate of Proficiency (CFC) in Automation, Automation Assembly, Electronics, Electrical Installation, Electrical Assembly, oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.

    • Advanced Federal Diploma (ES) oder University of Applied Sciences Degree (HES) ist ein Plus.

    • Erfahrung im Bereich der Leistungselektronik ist erwünscht.

    • Exzellente Französischkenntnisse; gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch sind erforderlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

    • Benefits

      >

    • >Parental Leave

      • >Fitness-Zulage>Fitness-Zulage

      Mehr über uns

      ABB Motion bietet Industriekunden zukunftsweisende Technologien, Produkte, Lösungen und damit verbundene Dienstleistungen, um die Energieeffizienz zu erhöhen, Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit zu verbessern und die Prozesse präzise zu kontrollieren. Das Portfolio umfasst Motoren, Generatoren und Antriebe für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen in allen Industriebereichen.

      Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird vom Talentpartner Ece Özen, Switzerland Ltd. geleitet.

      Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

jobs.title: (80 – 100%) IS Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide technical, business process and data advice to support ongoing operations and new software development. Each day, you will expand and utilize your knowledge on IS applications and emerging technologies. You will also showcase your expertise by overseeing the development, and validating the functionality, of the final IS application.

This role is contributing to all local divisions in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are business process owners, application owners and function managers across all organizational levels as well as local and global IS teams (architects, developers, IS security specialists, compliance specialists).

You will join a diverse and committed team where we support each other’s, and in which a self-reliant allrounder finds space to explore, grow, and excel.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid (min. 60% on site)


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Jointly with business stakeholders formulating user stories which document and "translate" business requirements into specifications for local or global development/support teams. Collaborating with these teams to ensure the use case and business user needs are understood.
  • Acting as a Subject Matter Expert in ongoing operations of IS applications, and participating in projects to introduce new or modify existing IS solutions/services, by contributing technology, business process and data expertise.
  • Supporting IS application power-users in resolving incidents and in further developing the functionality. Supporting them also in validating and user acceptance testing IS application solutions in stage environment. Formulating test scripts according to acceptance criteria.
  • Managing a specific IS application (for management of industrial standards), including budget responsibility. Providing efficient, requirement-compliant, and cost-effective provision and procurement of services for internal user groups.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Higher education degree in Computer Science or Business Informatics (University, University of Applied Sciences) or equivalent.
  • Fluent English and good German language skills (spoken and written).
  • Practical experience as an IS Functional Analyst or Business Analyst, preferably in an international environment. Experience as an IS Application Manager or IS Service Manager is advantageous.
  • Commitment to building trusted relationships to and consensus among various stakeholders. Ability to collaborate and communicate self-reliantly with all management levels.
  • Practical experience in requirements analysis and change management, as well as with the Software Development Lifecycle. Scrum or general Agile knowledge and Design Thinking knowledge are advantageous.
  • Talent and fondness for planning, organization, coordination, and communication.
  • Experience with or interest in industrial standards management or document management is an advantage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Jeden Tag erweitern und nutzen Sie Ihr Wissen über IS-Anwendungen und neue Technologien. Sie werden auch Ihr Fachwissen präsentieren, indem Sie die Entwicklung und Validierung der Funktionalität der endgültigen IS-Anwendung überwachen.

Diese Rolle trägt zu allen lokalen Divisionen in der Schweiz bei. Hauptakteure sind Business Process Owner, Application Owner und Funktionsmanager aller Organisationsebenen sowie lokale und globale IS-Teams (Architekten, Entwickler, IS-Security-Spezialisten, Compliance-Spezialisten).

Sie werden einem vielfältigen und engagierten Team beitreten, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen und in dem ein selbstständiger Allrounder Raum zum Erkunden, Wachsen und Übertreffen findet.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid #LI-hybrid (min. 60% vor Ort)


Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern aus der Wirtschaft formulieren User Stories, die Geschäftsanforderungen dokumentieren und in Spezifikationen für lokale oder globale Entwicklungs-/Supportteams "übersetzen". Zusammenarbeit mit diesen Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass der Anwendungsfall und die Bedürfnisse der Geschäftsbenutzer verstanden werden.
  • Als Subject Matter Expert im laufenden Betrieb von IS-Anwendungen tätig und an Projekten zur Einführung neuer oder Änderung bestehender IS-Lösungen / -Dienste beteiligt, indem sie Technologie, Geschäftsprozess- und Datenexpertise beitragen.
  • Unterstützung von Power-Usern von IS-Anwendungen bei der Lösung von Vorfällen und bei der Weiterentwicklung der Funktionalität. Unterstützung bei der Validierung und Prüfung der Benutzerakzeptanz von IS-Anwendungslösungen in einer Bühnenumgebung. Erstellung von Testskripten nach Akzeptanzkriterien.
  • Verwaltung einer spezifischen IS-Anwendung (für das Management industrieller Standards), einschließlich der Budgetverantwortung. Bereitstellung einer effizienten, bedarfsgerechten und kosteneffektiven Bereitstellung und Beschaffung von Diensten für interne Nutzergruppen.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik (Universität, Fachhochschule) oder gleichwertig.
  • Fluent Englisch und gute Deutschkenntnisse (gesprochen und geschrieben).

  • Verpflichtung zum Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu und Konsens zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen. Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und selbstständigen Kommunikation mit allen Managementebenen.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

At ABB, we develop battery systems and traction solutions that power trains, mining equipment, and industrial applications around the world. We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our battery development team in Untersiggenthal and contribute to the next generation of energy storage solutions.

This is an opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary environment alongside experts in battery technology, thermal management, materials, manufacturing, testing, and system engineering. We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex engineering challenges, and turning innovative ideas into practical solutions.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

What We Offer

  • Attractive and performance-based compensation

  • Flexible working models (hybrid)

  • Comprehensive further training and development opportunities

  • Modern working environment and international collaboration

  • Occupational social benefits and employee discounts

More About Us

ABB is a leading technology company that stands for a sustainable and high-performing future. Our solutions are active in the areas of electrification, automation and digitalization and help transform the way we live and work. Visit www.abb.com for more information about our solutions worldwide.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu führen, was die Welt beherrscht.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie Eigentümer des Trade Compliance Frameworks für die Local Business Line (LBL) und sind verantwortlich für die Festlegung, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Richtlinien, Prozesse, Kontrollen und Governance, die erforderlich sind, um eine konforme Ausführung unserer globalen Geschäftsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten. Sie stellen sicher, dass alle internationalen Geschäftstransaktionen, Projektlieferungen, Importe, Exporte, grenzüberschreitende Sendungen und damit verbundene Handelsaktivitäten in Übereinstimmung mit dem Global Trade Program von ABB und den geltenden Zoll-, Exportkontroll-, Sanktions- und Ursprungsbestimmungen durchgeführt werden. Als Trade Compliance Authority der LBL definieren und pflegen Sie das operative Trade Compliance Framework. Sie legen klare Prozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten, Kontrollen und Eskalationsmechanismen fest und gewährleisten eine effektive Umsetzung über alle relevanten Funktionen hinweg. Sie treiben die Integration von Trade-Compliance- • Anforderungen in den täglichen Betrieb voran und sind der wichtigste Punkt für komplexe Compliance-Angelegenheiten, regulatorische Änderungen und Risikominderung. Sie sind ferner verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Dokumentation und Aufrechterhaltung von Verfahren und Schulungsprogrammen im Zusammenhang mit Exportkontrollen, Sanktionen, Zoll und Ursprungsmanagement.

Arbeitsmodell ist: #LI-Hybrid


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Implementierung von Prozessen der Zollverfahren von LBL, des Ursprungsmanagements, des Sanktionslisten-Screenings, der Klassifizierung von Dual-Use-Listen und der Exportkontrollen.

  • Funktional führen Sie die Compliance-Ressourcen für den Handel im LBL.

  • Führen und überwachen Sie Trade Compliance innerhalb des lokalen Geschäftsbereichs (LBL), einschließlich der Implementierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Trade Compliance-Programms von ABB, interne Richtlinien, internes Kontrollsystem, lokale Handelsüberprüfungen, Selbstprüfungen und Korrekturmaßnahmen.

  • Bereitstellung von fachkundiger Beratung und Schulung zu Zoll-, Ursprungs-, Exportkontrolle und Sanktions-Compliance, Unterstützung der LBL, Koordination von Trade-Compliance-Ressourcen und -Support-Funktionen und Aufrechterhaltung einer starken Abstimmung mit wichtigen Stakeholdern wie CTCO, TCS, PCE, Deklaranten und Logistikteams.

  • Drive Trade Compliance im täglichen Betrieb und in komplexen Projekten, einschließlich Risikobewertungen, interner Kontrollen, Stammdaten und lieferantenbezogenen Compliance- • Anforderungen sowie regelmäßige Aktualisierungen der Stakeholder über den Umsetzungsfortschritt und relevante regulatorische Änderungen.

  • Beratung und Steuerung aller Trade-Compliance-Angelegenheiten in LBLs komplexen Projekten in verschiedenen Ländern


Was wir suchen:

  • Abschluss als Außenhandelsspezialist / Manager oder Exportkontrolle / Customs Compliance Officer mit mindestens 8 Jahren Erfahrung in einem relevanten Bereich (Senior Trade Compliance oder Legal/Compliance Hintergrund)

  • Hervorragende Erfahrung im Freihandel und in Bezug auf Präferenzursprünge sowie in Handels-Compliance-Fragen

  • Fluent in Englisch, Deutsch ist ein Plus

Das Verständnis und die Bewältigung von Herausforderungen und Chancen erfordern ein tiefes Fachwissen. Engineering und Lieferung von Automatisierungslösungen vom Gerät bis zur Überwachung und Steuerung machen unsere Kunden mehr aus ihrer Investition. Digitalisierungslösungen einschließlich kollaborativer Operationen und Augmented Reality helfen, die Produktivität von Anlagen und Unternehmen zu verbessern, Wartungs- und Energiekosten zu senken. À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Business Manager - E2E

Dans ce rôle, vous possédez le cadre de conformité commerciale du secteur d'activité local (LBL) et êtes responsable de l'établissement, de la mise en oeuvre et de l'amélioration continue des politiques, des processus, des contrôles et de la gouvernance nécessaires pour assurer la conformité de nos activités commerciales mondiales. Vous veillez à ce que toutes les transactions commerciales internationales, les livraisons de projets, les importations, les exportations, les expéditions transfrontalières et les activités commerciales connexes soient menées conformément au Programme commercial mondial d'ABB et aux règlements applicables en matière de douanes, de contrôle des exportations, de sanctions et d'origine. En tant qu'autorité de conformité commerciale de la LBL, vous définissez et maintenez le cadre opérationnel de conformité commerciale. Vous établissez des processus, des responsabilités, des contrôles et des mécanismes d'escalade clairs et assurez une mise en oeuvre efficace de toutes les fonctions pertinentes. Vous dirigez l'intégration des exigences de conformité commerciale dans les opérations quotidiennes et vous servez de point de départ pour les questions complexes de conformité, les changements réglementaires et l'atténuation des risques. Vous êtes également responsable de l'élaboration, de la documentation et du maintien des procédures et des programmes de formation liés aux contrôles à l'exportation, aux sanctions, aux douanes et à la gestion de l'origine.

Le modèle de travail est : #LI-Hybrid


Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Élaborer, améliorer et mettre en oeuvre les processus des procédures douanières, de la gestion de l'origine, de la présélection des listes de sanctions, de la classification à double usage et des contrôles à l'exportation.

  • Fonctionnellement diriger les ressources en matière de conformité commerciale dans la LBL.

  • Maîtriser et superviser la conformité commerciale dans le secteur d'activité local (LBL), y compris la mise en oeuvre et l'amélioration continue du Programme de conformité commerciale de l'ABB, des directives internes, du système de contrôle interne, des examens commerciaux locaux, des autovérifications et des mesures correctives.

  • Fournir des conseils et une formation d'experts sur le respect des douanes, de l'origine, du contrôle des exportations et des sanctions, appuyer la LBL, coordonner les ressources et les fonctions de soutien en matière de conformité commerciale, et maintenir une forte harmonisation avec les principaux intervenants tels que le CTCO, le TCS, le PCE, les déclarants et les équipes de logistique.

  • Instruire la conformité commerciale dans les opérations quotidiennes et les projets complexes, y compris les évaluations des risques, les vérifications internes, les données maîtresses et les exigences de conformité des fournisseurs, et informer régulièrement les intervenants sur les progrès de la mise en oeuvre et les modifications réglementaires pertinentes.

  • Ce que nous recherchons :

    • Devenir spécialiste du commerce extérieur / gestionnaire ou agent de contrôle des exportations / de conformité des douanes ayant au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans un domaine pertinent (conformité commerciale principale ou antécédents juridiques/de conformité)

    • Excellente expérience en matière de libre-échange et d'origines préférentielles ainsi que dans le domaine de la conformité commerciale

    • Solid knowledge in Swiss (GKV), EU and US (EAR) dual-use and sanctions regulations

    • Expérience dans une industrie ayant de grandes entreprises de projets dans divers pays et capacité en tant que chef de file et joueur d'équipe axé sur la solution

    • SAP et SAP GTS Expériences E4H

    • Fluent en anglais, l'allemand est un plus

      • Plus sur nous:

      La division Process Industries offre des solutions complètes d'électrification et d'automatisation, des produits spécifiques à l'industrie et des services de cycle de vie dans toutes les industries. La compréhension et le traitement des défis et des possibilités exigent une connaissance approfondie du domaine. L'ingénierie et la fourniture de solutions d'automatisation de l'appareil à la surveillance et au contrôle font que nos clients tirent davantage de leur investissement. Les solutions de numérisation, y compris les opérations collaboratives et la réalité augmentée, contribuent à améliorer la productivité des usines et des entreprises, à réduire les coûts d'entretien et d'énergie. Notre portefeuille d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet, de services et de solutions couvre un large éventail d'industries - Pulp, Paper & Fibre, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMD), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries telles que Cement, Food & Boissons, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

      Ce processus de recrutement est dirigé par Ceren Özen, chef d'équipe d'acquisition de talents, ABB Suisse.

      Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours, in line with business strategies focused on quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, and equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to meet the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection department in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive Improvement Projects – Identify opportunities, implement projects, and ensure adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost.

  • Process & Product Management – Provide work instructions, introduce engineering change notices, and approve process designs with final testing.

  • Production Support – Assist during process/equipment start-up, define action plans, and train maintenance and production teams.

  • Technology Evaluation – Assess new process technologies to boost productivity, quality, and cost efficiency, leading testing and provider selection.


• Qualifications for the role

  • A degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in operations and production line activities.

  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.

  • Proficiency in MS Office and 2D/3D CAD systems (CREO and/or SolidWorks required).

  • Positive spirit, Proactivity, teamwork, speediness, and problem-solving mindset; commitment to deliver results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects.

ABB Traction plays a critical role in shaping the future of electrified mobility. Through our traction battery packs and energy storage solutions, we enable customers globally to achieve higher efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in rail and off highway applications. We combine global scale with strong local execution to deliver performance, innovation, and long-term value.

Location

This role is open globally for ABB employees, but location is set in Switzerland. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

  • Establish technical thought-leadership and expertise in all relevant disciplines spanning from battery cells to battery systems – nurture an innovation pipeline to stay ahead of the competition
  • Own the ESS R&D budget and manage technology roadmaps, projects, and priorities in close alignment with the ESS product management function.

  • Build, develop and maintain strong relationships with all relevant internal and external stakeholders – ensure clarity at the interfaces to other functions, such as engineering, production and supply chain management
  • Take full responsibility for a safe working environment and for the correct implementation of guidelines and processes.

• Qualifications

  • Master degree in a STEM discipline
  • Proven direct or indirect leadership skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills
  • Experience in leading product or platform development in the field of propulsion or battery energy storage systems
  • Knowledge of industry standards and development processes relevant to railway and e-mobility applications
  • A high level of self-motivation, ownership, curiosity, and strong drive to stay one inch ahead
  • Must be fluent in English, fluency in German a strong plus
  • Candidates from the Traction Division will be given preferential consideration

What’s in it for you?

We give you the space to lead, the support to grow, and the chance to make a difference. Whether you're solving problems, building something new, or helping others succeed, your impact is real. Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of UPS systems and battery installations. You will diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring reliable and cost-effective solutions for our customers. Working in accordance with ABB policies, procedures, and safety standards, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of product quality and reliability. Leveraging your technical expertise and customer-focused approach, you will build strong relationships with customers and support the identification of new business opportunities. You will operate within ABB's established processes and quality standards, helping to deliver excellent service and customer satisfaction.


The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power Business in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Perform and coordinate repair and maintenance activities on UPS systems and battery installations, including fault diagnosis, testing, and inspections.

  • Manage and maintain loan equipment and UPS modules.

  • Ensure the proper maintenance and availability of tools, equipment, and testing facilities.

  • Assist with inventory and warehouse management, including the procurement of spare parts and consumable materials.

​

• Qualifications for the role

  • Successfully completed vocational training in Electrical Engineering (Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electronics Technician, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience working with UPS systems, battery installations, and power electronics.

  • Fluent German language skills; English and Italian proficiency is considered a plus.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Reliable, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work independently.

​

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credits

  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs

  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)

More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Installation, Wartung und Reparatur von USV-Systemen und Batterieinstallationen. Sie diagnostizieren und lösen technische Probleme effizient und gewährleisten zuverlässige und kostengünstige Lösungen für unsere Kunden. In Übereinstimmung mit ABB Richtlinien, Verfahren und Sicherheitsstandards tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Produktqualität und -zuverlässigkeit bei. Durch die Nutzung Ihrer technischen Expertise und Ihres kundenorientierten Ansatzes bauen Sie starke Beziehungen zu Kunden auf und unterstützen die Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Sie werden innerhalb der etablierten Prozesse und Qualitätsstandards von ABB arbeiten und dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und Kundenzufriedenheit zu liefern.


Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: onsite

Diese Rolle trägt zum Elektrifizierung, Smart Power Business in Baden, Kanton Aargau bei.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Durchführen und Koordinieren von Reparatur- und Wartungsaktivitäten an USV-Systemen und Batterieinstallationen, einschließlich Fehlerdiagnose, Tests und Inspektionen.

  • Verwalten und Instandhalten von Leihgeräten und USV-Modulen.

  • Gewährleisten Sie die ordnungsgemäße Wartung und Verfügbarkeit von Werkzeugen, Geräten und Testeinrichtungen.

  • Unterstützung beim Lager- und Lagermanagement, einschließlich der Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen und Verbrauchsmaterialien.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Elektrotechnik (Elektriker, Elektroinstallateur, Elektroniktechniker oder gleichwertig).

  • Bewährte Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit USV-Systemen, Batterieinstallationen und Leistungselektronik.

  • Fluent Deutschkenntnisse; Englisch- und Italienischkenntnisse gelten als Plus.

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten.

  • Zuverlässig, proaktiv und kundenorientiert, mit einem starken Verantwortungsbewusstsein und der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten.

Benefits

Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern auch die folgenden Vorteile an:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)

  • REKA Credits

    • < Elternurlaub

  • Beitrag zu Fitness- und Gesundheitsprogrammen

    • Eco Bonus (Nachhaltigkeitsanreiz)

Mehr über uns
ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.


Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Partner Ece Özen geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend approximately 80% of your time at customer sites. You will acquire new business partners and continuously develop existing customer relationships. By leveraging your technical expertise and sales experience, you will understand customer needs and clearly articulate the value of our electric motors and variable frequency drives (low voltage and medium voltage).

As a key driver of growth in our drives business, you will succeed through knowledgeable consulting and clear value‑based selling—ranging from energy efficiency to CO₂ reduction. Your objective is to deliver solutions that are not only technically strong but also contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industry.

This role follows a hybrid work model. #LI‑Hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

  • Customer Acquisition & Account Management: Spend approximately 80% of your time on site with customers, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.

  • Technical Consulting: Advise customers on electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV) and present solutions tailored to their technical and business requirements.

  • Value Communication: Clearly communicate the benefits of our products, including improved energy efficiency and reduced CO₂ emissions.

  • Relationship Management: Build trust, identify key stakeholders, and strategically position our solutions.

  • Market & Industry Awareness: Monitor trends in the drives and motion industry and contribute innovative ideas.

Your • Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical training in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of experience in sales, with strong knowledge of electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV).

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80% field‑based).

  • Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainable solutions.

  • Fluent in German and French.

What We Offer

  • An exciting sales role with significant autonomy and impact.

  • Access to innovative products and solutions within the Motion business area.

  • Ongoing learning opportunities and attractive career development prospects.

  • Modern work tools and flexible work arrangements.

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives offers a comprehensive portfolio of motors, generators, and drive products for a wide range of industries and applications. Our mission is to be a trusted expert in automated industrial systems, with a strong focus on reliability, long‑term partnerships, and a deep understanding of our customers’ needs.

The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Real Estate Portfolio Strategy Specialist (80%-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Real Estate Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Real Estate Portfolio Strategy Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping and executing ABB Switzerland’s real estate portfolio strategy, with a strong focus on investment, optimization, and divestment projects for ABB‑owned and leased sites.

You will manage complex and often confidential initiatives, coordinating closely with internal stakeholders (Business, Legal, Controlling, Accounting, Tax, Public Affairs) as well as external consultants, authorities, and transaction partners. Your ability to navigate financial, legal, and operational topics in parallel, while maintaining governance and timelines, will be critical to your success.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the development and execution of ABB's real estate portfolio and workplace strategies, ensuring alignment with business priorities, growth plans, and workplace transformation objectives while driving portfolio efficiency, occupancy optimization, cost effectiveness, and long-term value creation.

  • Manage complex real estate transactions and portfolio initiatives, including investments, divestments, consolidations, restructurings, lease events, and workplace transformation projects across owned and leased facilities, ensuring compliance with governance processes, financial targets, approval requirements, and risk management standards.

  • Drive portfolio performance and decision-making through robust financial and operational analysis, including business case development, occupancy cost assessments, ROI evaluations, scenario modeling, utilization reviews, vacancy analysis, and portfolio recommendations to support local and global senior management.

  • Act as a senior business partner and project leader, collaborating with business, finance, legal, HR, procurement, landlords, developers, authorities, and external advisors to forecast future space demand, oversee due diligence and lease negotiations, and deliver real estate solutions that enhance employee experience, sustainability performance, operational effectiveness, and financial outcomes.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio management, development, transactions, or a related field, with solid knowledge of the Swiss real estate and construction market.

  • Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Business Administration, Finance, or comparable discipline.

  • Strong financial acumen, including the ability to analyze and interpret financial statements, evaluate investment and divestment business cases, assess risks and returns, and support fact‑based decision‑making at management level.

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and service‑oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a dynamic and demanding environment.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence interacting at senior management level.

  • Strong organizational and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Fluency in German and English is essential.

More about us

Our mission in Real Estate (RE) is to enable ABB businesses to perform at their best through a global real estate management that covers the full end-to-end lifecycle from site selection, management and maintenance to site termination. We have a passion for operational excellence and make every effort to create value for ABB businesses. Our efforts grow out of a commitment to provide healthy and engaging work environments, improve energy efficiency and sustainability and optimize space efficiency for all our buildings in more than 100 countries all over the world. We value people from different backgrounds.

Could this be your story?

Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

The recruiting process is led by Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
