descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu führen, was die Welt regiert.

Als Spezialist für Immobilienportfoliostrategie von ABB Schweiz spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung der Immobilienportfoliostrategie von ABB Schweiz mit einem starken Fokus auf Investitions-, Optimierungs- und Desinvestitionsprojekten für ABB-eigene und geleaste Standorte.

Sie verwalten komplexe und oft vertrauliche Initiativen und stimmen sich eng mit internen Stakeholdern (Business, Legal, Controlling, Accounting, Tax, Public Affairs) sowie externen Beratern, Behörden und Transaktionspartnern ab. Ihre Fähigkeit, finanzielle, rechtliche und operative Themen parallel zu navigieren und gleichzeitig Governance und Zeitpläne beizubehalten, wird für Ihren Erfolg entscheidend sein.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für

  • Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Immobilienportfolio- und Arbeitsplatzstrategien von ABB und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung auf Geschäftsprioritäten, Wachstumspläne und Arbeitsplatztransformationsziele und fördern Sie gleichzeitig die Portfolioeffizienz, die Nutzungsoptimierung, die Kosteneffizienz und die langfristige Wertschöpfung.

  • Verwalten Sie komplexe Immobilientransaktionen und Portfolioinitiativen, einschließlich Investitionen, Veräußerungen, Konsolidierungen, Restrukturierungen, Leasingveranstaltungen und Arbeitsplatztransformationsprojekte in eigenen und geleasten Einrichtungen, um die Einhaltung von Governance-Prozessen, finanziellen Zielen, Genehmigungsanforderungen und Risikomanagementstandards sicherzustellen.

  • Steigerung der Portfolio-Performance und Entscheidungsfindung durch robuste Finanz- und Betriebsanalysen, einschließlich Business Case-Entwicklung, Belegungskostenbewertungen, ROI-Bewertungen, Szenariomodellierung, Auslastungsüberprüfungen, Vakanzanalyse und Portfolioempfehlungen zur Unterstützung des lokalen und globalen Senior Managements.

  • Handeln Sie als Senior Geschäftspartner und Projektleiter und arbeiten Sie mit Unternehmen, Finanzen, Recht, Personal, Beschaffung, Vermietern, Entwicklern, Behörden und externen Beratern zusammen, um den zukünftigen Flächenbedarf zu prognostizieren, die Due Diligence und Mietverhandlungen zu überwachen und Immobilienlösungen zu liefern, die die Erfahrung der Mitarbeiter, die Nachhaltigkeitsleistung, die operative Effektivität und die finanziellen Ergebnisse verbessern.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Mindest 8 Jahre Erfahrung in Corporate Real Estate, Portfoliomanagement, Entwicklung, Transaktionen oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit soliden Kenntnissen des Schweizer Immobilien- und Baumarktes.

  • Bachelor-Abschlusses in Immobilien, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen oder vergleichbarer Disziplin.

  • Starker finanzieller Scharfsinn, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu analysieren und zu interpretieren, Investitions- und Desinvestitionsgeschäftsfälle zu bewerten, Risiken und Renditen zu bewerten und die faktenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung auf Managementebene zu unterstützen.

  • Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit Vertrauen in der Geschäftsleitung.

  • Strong organisatorische und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist w/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB Switzerland’s local sales organization as well as our customers throughout the entire quotation process in the field of drive technology. You will act as the central technical point of contact within your area of responsibility and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.


• Your responsibilities include optimally sizing products for customers to best meet their requirements and applicable standards. In addition, you will calculate costs and prepare quotations with the relevant technical information. You will apply your technical expertise in a targeted manner and make a significant contribution to the successful preparation of proposals.


Work model: Hybrid


This position supports the local sales unit (Motion) in Baden, Canton Aargau.


Your main responsibilities

  • Technical consulting & solution development: You support sales and customers in selecting technically optimal and economically viable solutions for drive and automation systems.
  • End-to-end quotation management: You prepare and calculate technical and commercial quotations and support them through to successful completion.
  • Analysis & optimization: You analyze customer needs, market and competitor information, as well as lost opportunities, and derive targeted improvement measures.
  • Collaboration & quality assurance: You work closely with sales, business units, and other stakeholders and ensure compliance with quality, compliance, and HSE standards.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed technical education (e.g., automation technician, electronics technician, automation specialist, or similar)
  • Several years of professional experience (min. 5 years) in sales support, sales, or project environments
  • Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
  • Analytical mindset and understanding of markets and processes
  • Initiative, structured way of working, and assertiveness
  • Advantageous: French language skills and further education at HF level (e.g., certified technician HF)

Benefits

• We offer, among others:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us

ABB Motion provides industrial customers with cutting-edge technologies, products, solutions, and related services to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and ensure precise control of processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators, and drives for a wide range of applications across all industries.


The recruitment process is managed by Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead a regional service team with diverse expertise in service planning, order processing, and service execution within the Electrification business area. Together with your team, you will ensure comprehensive customer support for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems across the German-speaking region of Switzerland.


Reporting directly to the Head of Service UPS Systems, you will make a significant contribution to the implementation of the service strategy and the promotion of business growth. Through efficient planning and targeted allocation of resources, while ensuring compliance with established processes, procedures, and guidelines, you will drive high service quality and operational excellence.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading, coaching, and developing a regional service team consisting of Service Coordinators, Order Handling Specialists, Technical Support Engineers, and Field Service Technicians, while fostering a motivating, safe, and performance-oriented work environment.
  • Taking overall responsibility for all service activities, customer orders, and maintenance operations within the region, ensuring the achievement of quality, performance, and commercial targets, maintaining customer relationships, and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Providing operational support to the team (approximately 60% of the role) in service planning (FSL), including the review and approval of weekly reports and expense claims.
  • Ensuring the implementation of and compliance with all occupational health and safety requirements.


Your • Qualifications

  • Technical vocational training in Electrical Engineering, complemented by a job-related advanced qualification at Higher Technical College level (e.g., Certified Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent).
  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in the maintenance, servicing, commissioning, and repair of electrical installations.
  • Experience with power electronics and/or UPS systems.
  • Several years of leadership experience in a similar position.
  • A flexible and resilient personality with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A structured and solution-oriented approach to work and problem-solving.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Switzerland.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications as well as SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; French and Italian are an advantage.


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs
  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)


More About Us

ABB’s Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes product care, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, maximize the value derived from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their lifecycle.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

<
    Leader, coaching e sviluppo di un team di assistenza regionale composto da Coordinatori del Servizio, Specialisti di Gestione degli Ordini, Ingegneri di Supporto Tecnici e Tecnici del Servizio di Campo, mentre favorisce un ambiente di lavoro motivante, sicuro e orientato alle prestazioni. Assumendo la responsabilità generale per tutte le attività di servizio, gli ordini del cliente e le operazioni di manutenzione all'interno della regione, assicurando il raggiungimento di obiettivi qualitativi, prestazionali e commerciali, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e offrendo elevati livelli di soddisfazione del cliente. Fornire supporto operativo al team (circa il 60% del ruolo) nella pianificazione dei servizi (FSL), compresa la revisione e l'approvazione dei rapporti settimanali e delle richieste di spesa. Assicurare l'attuazione e il rispetto di tutti i requisiti di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro. Il tuo • Qualifiche Formazione professionale tecnica in Ingegneria Elettrica, completata da una qualifica avanzata legata al lavoro a livello di Higher Technical College (ad esempio, Tecnico Certificato, Artigiano Maestro, o equivalente). Forte conoscenza tecnica e esperienza pratica nella manutenzione, manutenzione, messa in servizio e riparazione di impianti elettrici. Una personalità flessibile e resiliente con forti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione. Volontà di viaggiare in tutta la Svizzera. Proficienza nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office e nei sistemi SAP o altri ERP. Ottimo stile tedesco e inglese, sia scritto che parlato; francese e italiano sono un vantaggio. Riduzioni dei dipendenti esclusivi (MyDiscounts / Swibeco) ABB Service Division collabora con i clienti per migliorare la disponibilità, l’affidabilità, la prevedibilità e la sostenibilità dei prodotti e delle installazioni elettriche. Il portafoglio di servizi completo della divisione comprende servizi di assistenza, modernizzazione e consulenza progettati per migliorare le prestazioni, estendere la durata delle attrezzature e raggiungere nuovi livelli di efficienza operativa e sostenibile. Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a mantenere le risorse in uso il più a lungo possibile, massimizzare il valore derivato da loro, e recuperare e rigenerare prodotti e materiali alla fine del loro ciclo di vita. Questo processo di reclutamento è gestito da Talent Partner Ece Özen. Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Questo è il motivo per cui accogliamo le persone da tutti i background e le esperienze.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you will be working on sensing solutions for ABB’s next generation systems and products. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

  • Disseminate your results with scientific publications and internal technical reports, generate intellectual property.

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt beherrscht.

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten
< Als Research Scientist arbeiten Sie an Sensorlösungen für Systeme und Produkte der nächsten Generation von ABB. Wir suchen ein Teammitglied mit einer nachgewiesenen Forschungsbilanz und dem Eifer, erstklassige akademische Forschung in ein industrielles Umfeld zu übertragen und anzuwenden. Sie arbeiten im hochmotivierten, internationalen Team von Wissenschaftlern bei ABB Research. • Wir bieten ein offenes und innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit vielen verschiedenen Möglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu fördern.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Beitrag zu und Leitung von Forschungsprojekten im Bereich der Sensoren und industriellen Sensorikanwendungen, die auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Unternehmen eingehen, mit Anwendungen wie Automatisierung, Prozessindustrie und Elektrifizierung.
  • Entwickeln Sie gemeinsam mit multidisziplinären Projektteams neuartige, hochwertige Sensorprodukte und Lösungen von der Konzeptdefinitionsphase bis zur experimentellen Verifikation.
  • Bewerten Sie neue Technologien und führen Sie technische Umfragen durch, erstellen Sie Projektvorschläge mit geschäftlicher Wirkung und arbeiten Sie mit Forschern und Ingenieuren anderer Forschungszentren, ABB-Geschäftseinheiten sowie von Universitäten zusammen.
  • Verbreiten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse mit wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und internen technischen Berichten, generieren Sie geistiges Eigentum.


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • PhD-Universitätsabschluss in Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen
  • Theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in Signalverarbeitung und Datenanalyse (einschließlich ML / Deep-Learning-basiert) z.B. Entrauschen, Merkmalsextraktion, Zeitreihenanalyse und Anomalieerkennung, Signalklassifizierung und Mustererkennung
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Test, Design, Simulation und Validierung von elektronischen Systemen, eingebetteter Elektronik, (drahtloser) Konnektivität, Testmethoden und datengesteuerter Validierung, Edge / Embedded ML-Bereitstellung
  • Solide Erfahrung, Ideen von Konzepten zu Prototypen zu bringen
  • Starkes Interesse an Sensortechnologien und Integration von Sensoren in Systeme. Kontextwissen in elektrifizierungsbezogenen Anwendungen als Plus
  • Kenntnisse in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (C/C++, Python, Matlab und moderne ML-Frameworks -PyTorch-) und Verwendung von Codierungsagenten
  • Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamplayer-Haltung und ausgezeichnete Beherrschung (schriftlich und mündlich) der englischen Sprache

Mehr über uns

Das ABB-Forschungszentrum in Baden-Dättwil, Schweiz, untersucht neue Technologien, die die Entwicklung der Produkte und Lösungen der nächsten Generation von ABB unterstützen und vorantreiben. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems und Switching.

Ce poste relève de:

Gestionnaire du département de recherche

Votre rôle et responsabilités

En tant que chercheur scientifique, vous travaillerez sur des solutions de détection pour les systèmes et produits de prochaine génération d'ABB. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un membre de l'équipe qui possède une expérience de recherche éprouvée et qui est désireux de transférer et d'appliquer la recherche universitaire de classe mondiale dans un environnement industriel. Vous travaillerez au sein de l'équipe internationale hautement motivée de scientifiques d'ABB Research. • Nous offrons un milieu de travail ouvert et innovateur offrant de nombreuses possibilités d'avancement professionnel.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Contribuer et diriger des projets de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs et des applications de détection industrielle répondant aux besoins de nos entreprises, y compris les applications d'automatisation, les industries de procédés et l'électrification.
  • En collaboration avec des équipes de projet multidisciplinaires, élaborer de nouveaux produits et solutions de détection à haute valeur ajoutée depuis la phase de définition du concept jusqu'à la vérification expérimentale.
    • Évaluer les nouvelles technologies et mener des enquêtes techniques, produire des propositions de projets ayant un impact sur les entreprises et collaborer avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs d'autres centres de recherche, des unités d'affaires d'ABB ainsi que des universités.
    • Diffuser vos résultats avec des publications scientifiques et des rapports techniques internes, générer la propriété intellectuelle.


    • Qualifications pour le rôle

    • Doctorat universitaire en génie électrique, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe
    • Connaissances théoriques et pratiques en traitement des signaux et en analyse des données (y compris ML/deep-learning-based) ex. dénigrement, extraction de fonctions, analyse de séries chronologiques et détection d'anomalies, classification des signaux et reconnaissance des patrons
    • Expérience pratique de l'essai, de la conception, de la simulation et de la validation des systèmes électroniques, de l'électronique embarquée, de la connectivité (sans fil), des méthodes d'essai et de la validation axée sur les données, du déploiement de ML bord/embed
    • Expérience solide d'obtenir des idées des concepts aux prototypes
    • Intérêt marqué pour les technologies de détection et l'intégration des capteurs dans les systèmes. Connaissance du contexte dans les applications liées à l'électrification considérées comme un plus
    • Compétence dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (C/C++, Python, Matlab et les cadres ML modernes -PyTorch-), et utilisation d'agents de codage
    • Excellentes compétences en communication et attitude de joueur d'équipe et excellente commande (écrite et orale) de la langue anglaise

    Plus d'informations sur nous

    Le Centre de recherche ABB situé à Baden-Dättwil, en Suisse, est l'endroit où nous étudions de nouvelles technologies qui soutiennent et conduisent le développement de produits et de solutions de nouvelle génération d'ABB. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutateur.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this versatile role, you will be responsible for the successful execution of customer projects involving medium-voltage switchgear and other electrical engineering solutions for the Swiss market. You will manage your projects from order handover through delivery and successful completion, acting as the central point of contact for our customers.

You will work closely with the project and engineering teams at our international supply factories as well as with local specialist functions. You will manage a portfolio of projects of varying sizes and ensure compliance with schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.

The work model for this position is: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

This position is part of the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

Your main responsibilities

  • End-to-end project responsibility: Manage multiple customer projects from order handover through delivery and completion, representing ABB as the central point of contact for our customers.

  • Planning and coordination: Plan and manage schedules, scope of supply, and interfaces, while coordinating collaboration with international supply factories, factory project managers, engineering, production, logistics, and local partners.

  • Commercial project management: Monitor project costs, risks, changes, and claims, identify deviations at an early stage, and implement appropriate actions in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Project close-out and continuous improvement: Take responsibility for customer acceptance, project documentation, and commercial close-out, and actively contribute your experience and lessons learned to the continuous improvement of our project execution processes.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • At least three years of experience independently managing multiple customer projects, with demonstrated end-to-end responsibility for projects of appropriate technical and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated professional experience with electrical installations, electrical products, or electrical system solutions. A qualification or degree in electrical engineering and experience with medium-voltage switchgear are considered an advantage.

  • Proven practical ability to manage schedules, costs, risks, changes, and interfaces in an industrial, customer-focused, and delivery-oriented environment.

  • Very good German and English skills, enabling you to independently and confidently conduct demanding customer discussions, manage escalations, and handle commercial and contractual negotiations.

  • A structured, independent, and pragmatic way of working, combined with the ability to prioritize and transparently manage multiple projects of varying sizes and to take a solution-oriented approach when deviations occur.

  • Practical knowledge of commonly used project management and collaboration tools. An entry-level project management certification or a comparable qualification is expected. Applicants with demonstrated practical project management experience and a willingness to complete the certification through our internal project management program will also be considered

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.
With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kV), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.
We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this versatile role, you will be responsible for the successful execution of customer projects involving medium-voltage switchgear and other electrical engineering solutions for the Swiss market. You will manage your projects from order handover through delivery and successful completion, acting as the central point of contact for our customers.

You will work closely with the project and engineering teams at our international supply factories as well as with local specialist functions. You will manage a portfolio of projects of varying sizes and ensure compliance with schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.

The work model for this position is: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

This position is part of the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

Your main responsibilities

  • End-to-end project responsibility: Manage multiple customer projects from order handover through delivery and completion, representing ABB as the central point of contact for our customers.

  • Planning and coordination: Plan and manage schedules, scope of supply, and interfaces, while coordinating collaboration with international supply factories, factory project managers, engineering, production, logistics, and local partners.

  • Commercial project management: Monitor project costs, risks, changes, and claims, identify deviations at an early stage, and implement appropriate actions in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Project close-out and continuous improvement: Take responsibility for customer acceptance, project documentation, and commercial close-out, and actively contribute your experience and lessons learned to the continuous improvement of our project execution processes.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • At least three years of experience independently managing multiple customer projects, with demonstrated end-to-end responsibility for projects of appropriate technical and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated professional experience with electrical installations, electrical products, or electrical system solutions. A qualification or degree in electrical engineering and experience with medium-voltage switchgear are considered an advantage.

  • Proven practical ability to manage schedules, costs, risks, changes, and interfaces in an industrial, customer-focused, and delivery-oriented environment.

  • Very good German and English skills, enabling you to independently and confidently conduct demanding customer discussions, manage escalations, and handle commercial and contractual negotiations.

  • A structured, independent, and pragmatic way of working, combined with the ability to prioritize and transparently manage multiple projects of varying sizes and to take a solution-oriented approach when deviations occur.

  • Practical knowledge of commonly used project management and collaboration tools. An entry-level project management certification or a comparable qualification is expected. Applicants with demonstrated practical project management experience and a willingness to complete the certification through our internal project management program will also be considered

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.
With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kV), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.
We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Project Operations Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle sind Sie für die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Kundenprojekten mit Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen und anderen elektrotechnischen Lösungen für den Schweizer Markt verantwortlich. Sie managen Ihre Projekte von der Auftragsübergabe über die Lieferung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss und fungieren als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden.

Sie arbeiten eng mit den Projekt- und Ingenieurteams unserer internationalen Zulieferfabriken sowie mit lokalen Fachfunktionen zusammen. Sie verwalten ein Portfolio von Projekten unterschiedlicher Größe und stellen die Einhaltung von Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität und vertraglichen Anforderungen sicher.

Das Arbeitsmodell für diese Position lautet: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

Diese Position ist Teil des Geschäftsbereichs Electrification Distribution Solutions in der Schweiz.

Ihre Hauptverantwortung

  • End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Verwalten mehrerer Kundenprojekte von der Auftragsübergabe bis zur Lieferung und Fertigstellung, wobei ABB als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden fungiert.

  • Planung und Koordination: Planung und Verwaltung von Zeitplänen, Lieferumfang und Schnittstellen, während die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Zulieferfabriken, Projektmanagern, Ingenieuren, Produktion, Logistik und lokalen Partnern koordiniert wird.

  • Kommerzielles Projektmanagement: Projektkosten, Risiken, Änderungen und Ansprüche überwachen, Abweichungen frühzeitig erkennen und geeignete Maßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umsetzen.

  • Projekt-Close-Out und kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für Kundenakzeptanz, Projektdokumentation und kommerzielle Close-Out und bringen Sie Ihre Erfahrungen und Erfahrungen aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Projektabwicklungsprozesse ein.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der unabhängigen Verwaltung mehrerer Kundenprojekte mit nachgewiesener End-to-End-Verantwortung für Projekte von angemessener technischer und organisatorischer Komplexität.

  • Demonstrierte Berufserfahrung mit elektrischen Installationen, elektrischen Produkten oder elektrischen Systemlösungen. Eine Qualifikation oder ein Abschluss in Elektrotechnik und Erfahrung mit Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen gelten als Vorteil.

  • Bewährte praktische Fähigkeit, Zeitpläne, Kosten, Risiken, Änderungen und Schnittstellen in einer industriellen, kundenorientierten und lieferungsorientierten Umgebung zu verwalten.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, unabhängig und selbstbewusst anspruchsvolle Kundengespräche zu führen, Eskalationen zu managen und kaufmännische und vertragliche Verhandlungen zu führen.

  • Eine strukturierte, unabhängige und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte unterschiedlicher Größe zu priorisieren und transparent zu managen und bei Abweichungen einen lösungsorientierten Ansatz zu verfolgen.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse der gängigen Projektmanagement- und Collaboration-Tools. Es wird eine Entry-Level Projektmanagement Zertifizierung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erwartet. Bewerber mit nachgewiesener praktischer Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und der Bereitschaft, die Zertifizierung durch unser internes Projektmanagement-Programm abzuschließen, werden ebenfalls berücksichtigt

Mehr über uns

>ABBs Division Distribution Solutions bietet Mittelspannungskomponenten, Schaltanlagen und Lösungen, die das sich entwickelnde Stromnetz verbinden und schützen und eine zuverlässige und vorhersehbare Energieverteilung gewährleisten. Wir verbinden Hochspannungssysteme mit Mittel- und Niederspannungsverbrauchern und gewährleisten eine kontinuierliche Stromversorgung für Industrie-, Gewerbe- und Privatanwender und ermöglichen gleichzeitig die Integration erneuerbarer Energiequellen in das Netz. Unsere intelligenten Lösungen, powered by AI, verbessern die Netzresistenz und optimieren die Nutzung des elektrischen Systems.
Mit ABB AbilityTM-fähigen vernetzten Lösungen umfasst das Angebot Mittelspannungs-luft- und gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (1 bis 46 kV), Innen- und Außenleistungsschalter, Schutzrelais, Messwandler, Sensoren und Lösungen für Verteilerstationen.
Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden und Partner dabei, den zunehmenden Elektrifizierungsbedarf, die Technologie und die regulatorischen Änderungen immer weiter zu steigern und bieten die Möglichkeit, sich an eine sich schnell entwickelnde Energielandschaft anzupassen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (Dokumente, die in englischer Sprache eingereicht werden, werden geschätzt). Den Recruiting-Prozess leitet Reto Korstick, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland Ltd. Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, werfen Sie einen weiteren Blick auf unsere Website www.abb.com.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des opérations de projet

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle polyvalent, vous serez responsable de l'exécution réussie de projets clients impliquant des commutateurs à moyenne tension et d'autres solutions d'ingénierie électrique pour le marché suisse. Vous gérerez vos projets depuis le transfert de la commande jusqu'à la livraison et l'achèvement réussi, agissant comme point de contact central pour nos clients.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de projet et d'ingénierie de nos usines internationales d'approvisionnement ainsi qu'avec des fonctions spécialisées locales. Vous gérerez un portefeuille de projets de différentes tailles et vous assurerez la conformité avec le calendrier, le coût, la qualité et les exigences contractuelles.

Le modèle de travail pour ce poste est : Hybrid #LI-hybrid

Ce poste fait partie de l'activité de commutateur de tension moyenne de la division Solutions de distribution d'électrification en Suisse.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Responsabilité du projet de bout en bout : gérer plusieurs projets clients depuis la remise des commandes jusqu'à la livraison et à l'achèvement, représentant ABB comme point de contact central pour nos clients.

  • Planification et coordination : Planifier et gérer les calendriers, l'étendue de l'approvisionnement et les interfaces, tout en coordonnant la collaboration avec les usines internationales d'approvisionnement, les gestionnaires de projets d'usine, l'ingénierie, la production, la logistique et les partenaires locaux.

  • Gestion de projets commerciaux : Surveiller les coûts, les risques, les changements et les réclamations, repérer les écarts à un stade précoce et mettre en oeuvre les mesures appropriées en collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes.

  • Clôture du projet et amélioration continue : assumez la responsabilité de l'acceptation du client, de la documentation du projet et de la clôture commerciale, et contribuez activement à l'amélioration continue de nos processus d'exécution du projet.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Au moins trois ans d'expérience en gestion indépendante de plusieurs projets clients, avec une responsabilité démontrée de bout en bout pour des projets de complexité technique et organisationnelle appropriée.

  • Expérience professionnelle démontrée avec des installations électriques, des produits électriques ou des solutions de systèmes électriques. Une qualification ou un diplôme en génie électrique et l'expérience de la commande à moyenne tension sont considérés comme un avantage.

  • Capacité pratique éprouvée de gérer les horaires, les coûts, les risques, les changements et les interfaces dans un environnement industriel, axé sur le client et axé sur la prestation.

  • De très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, vous permettant de mener de façon indépendante et confiante des discussions avec les clients exigeants, de gérer des escalades et de gérer des négociations commerciales et contractuelles.

  • Une façon de travailler structurée, indépendante et pragmatique, combinée à la capacité de prioriser et de gérer de façon transparente plusieurs projets de différentes tailles et d'adopter une approche axée sur la solution lorsque des écarts se produisent.

  • Connaissance pratique des outils de gestion et de collaboration de projets couramment utilisés. On s'attend à obtenir une certification de gestion de projet ou une qualification comparable. Les candidats possédant une expérience pratique de gestion de projet démontrée et la volonté de terminer la certification par le biais de notre programme interne de gestion de projet seront également considérés

Plus au sujet de nous

La division Solutions de distribution d'ABB fournit des composants à moyenne tension, des commutateurs et des solutions qui relient et protègent le réseau électrique en évolution, assurant une distribution d'énergie fiable et prévisible. Nous lions les systèmes à haute tension aux consommateurs à moyenne et basse tension, assurant la distribution continue d'énergie aux utilisateurs industriels, commerciaux et résidentiels tout en permettant l'intégration des sources d'énergie renouvelables dans le réseau. Nos solutions intelligentes, alimentées par l'IA, améliorent la résilience du réseau et optimisent l'utilisation du système électrique.
Avec les solutions connectées ABB CapabilityTM, l'offre comprend des commutateurs à moyenne tension à air et à gaz (1 à 46 kV), des disjoncteurs intérieurs et extérieurs, des relais de protection, des transformateurs d'instruments, des capteurs et des solutions pour stations de distribution.
Nous aidons nos clients et partenaires à rester en avance sur l'augmentation des besoins en électrification, de la technologie et des changements réglementaires, fournissant ainsi le pouvoir de s'adapter à un paysage énergétique en évolution rapide.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre demande (les documents présentés en anglais sont appréciés). Le recrutement est dirigé par Reto Korstick, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland Ltd. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site Web www.abb.com.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Digital Technology Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sub GBU Technology Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As Digital Technology Manager you will be responsible for leading the development and execution of the digital technology roadmap for the ELSE division. This strategic role leads digital innovation and the evolution of the division’s global digital portfolio. The position bridges business strategy with technology implementation, ensuring that the ELSE division achieves its future growth targets and leadership in digital.

The preferred work model for this role is hybrid, although remote work is also acceptable.

This role is contributing to the Global R&D of ELSE Division. Main stakeholders are R&D Technology Manager, Digital Lead and Product Managementt.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Define and evolve the global technology roadmap for digital products, Cloud software, software tools, and embedded systems in close collaboration with Digital Lead, Digital Transformation Manager, Product Line Managers, and Product Managers
  • Collaborate with R&D Team Managers to ensure appropriate competences in the teams and properly defined objectives in line with the overall R&D strategy
  • Identify emerging technologies together with the R&D and Corporate Research teams and drive collaboration and knowledge transfer
  • Manage investments, resources, key risks, and relevant IP in the area of responsibility.
  • Drive innovation, define technology standards and guide architectural decisions for the digital platforms of the division
  • Establish common development processes, tools, architecture principles, and quality standards across teams.
  • Coordinate local and global teams and partners, ensuring that appropriate actions and decisions are taken to manage conflicts or resolve technical problems.

• Qualifications for the role
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline
  • 10+ years in digital technology management role with experience in defining technology roadmaps and leading complex development portfolios
  • Sound experience in leading development process from requirements to product launch. Mastery in Agile methodologies and experience in Gate Model or equivalent process
  • Solid knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and system architecture
  • Understanding of IoT, edge computing, and industrial automation technologies
  • Ability to influence without authority in matrix organizations and to work across countries and cultures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent project and program management abilities
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to travel is required, estimated up to 20% travel



More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Identifizieren Sie neue Technologien zusammen mit R&D und Corporate Research Teams und fördern Sie die Zusammenarbeit und den Wissenstransfer

  • Innovation vorantreiben, Technologiestandards definieren und architektonische Entscheidungen für die digitalen Plattformen der Division leiten
  • Teamübergreifend gemeinsame Entwicklungsprozesse, Tools, Architekturprinzipien und Qualitätsstandards etablieren.
  • Koordination lokaler und globaler Teams und Partner, um sicherzustellen, dass geeignete Maßnahmen und Entscheidungen getroffen werden, um Konflikte zu bewältigen oder technische Probleme zu lösen.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle
  • Master-Abschluss in Informatik, IT, Engineering oder verwandten Disziplin
  • 10+ Jahre in der Rolle des digitalen Technologiemanagements mit Erfahrung in der Definition von Technologie-Roadmaps und der Leitung komplexer Entwicklungsportfolios
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im führenden Entwicklungsprozess von den Anforderungen bis zur Produkteinführung. Beherrschung von agilen Methoden und Erfahrung im Gate-Modell oder gleichwertigen Prozess
  • Festes Wissen über Cloud-Plattformen (Azure bevorzugt) und Systemarchitektur
  • Verständnis von IoT, Edge Computing und industriellen Automatisierungstechnologien
  • Fähigkeit, ohne Autorität in Matrixorganisationen zu beeinflussen und länder- und kulturübergreifend zu arbeiten
  • Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.
  • Exzellente Projekt- und Programmmanagementfähigkeiten
  • Starke Kommunikations- und Stakeholdermanagementfähigkeiten. Fließend in Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen
  • Reiseverfügbarkeit ist erforderlich, geschätzt bis zu 20% Reisen



Mehr über uns

Die Service Division von ABB arbeitet mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um die Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Vorhersagbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit von elektrischen Produkten und Anlagen zu verbessern. Das umfangreiche Serviceportfolio der Division bietet Produktpflege, Modernisierung und Beratung, um die Leistung zu verbessern, die Lebensdauer der Ausrüstung zu verlängern und neue Ebenen der betrieblichen und nachhaltigen Effizienz zu bieten. Wir helfen Kunden, Ressourcen so lange wie möglich im Einsatz zu halten, den maximalen Wert daraus zu ziehen und dann Produkte und Materialien am Ende ihrer Nutzungsdauer zu gewinnen und zu regenerieren.

Steigen Sie sich uns an. Werden Sie Teil des Teams, in dem Fortschritt stattfindet, sich Industrien verändern und Ihre Arbeit die Welt prägt. Run What Runs the World.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Ce poste relève de :

Sous GBU Technology Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

En tant que gestionnaire de technologie numérique, vous serez chargé de diriger l'élaboration et l'exécution de la feuille de route technologique numérique pour la division ELSE. Ce rôle stratégique dirige l'innovation numérique et l'évolution du portefeuille numérique mondial de la division. La position établit un lien entre la stratégie opérationnelle et la mise en oeuvre de la technologie, en veillant à ce que la division ELSE atteigne ses objectifs de croissance et son leadership dans le domaine du numérique.

Le modèle de travail préféré pour ce rôle est hybride, bien que le travail à distance soit également acceptable.

Ce rôle contribue à la R-D mondiale de la Division ELSE. Les principaux intervenants sont Gestionnaire de la technologie de R-D, Direction numérique et gestion des produits.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :
  • Définir et développer la feuille de route technologique mondiale pour les produits numériques, les logiciels Cloud, les outils logiciels et les systèmes intégrés en étroite collaboration avec le responsable numérique, le gestionnaire de la transformation numérique, les gestionnaires de gamme de produits et les gestionnaires de produits
  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d'équipes de R-D pour s'assurer que les compétences des équipes sont appropriées et que les objectifs sont bien définis conformément à la stratégie globale de R-D
  • Identifier les technologies émergentes en collaboration avec les équipes de R-D et de recherche ministérielle et favoriser la collaboration et le transfert des connaissances
  • Gérer les investissements, les ressources, les risques clés et la propriété intellectuelle dans le domaine de responsabilité. Les résultats de l'enquête sont présentés dans le tableau ci-dessous. Favoriser l'innovation, définir des normes technologiques et guider les décisions architecturales pour les plateformes numériques de la division
  • Établir des processus de développement, des outils, des principes d'architecture et des normes de qualité communs à toutes les équipes. Les résultats de l'enquête sont présentés dans le tableau ci-dessous. Coordonner les équipes et les partenaires locaux et mondiaux, en veillant à ce que des mesures et des décisions appropriées soient prises pour gérer les conflits ou résoudre les problèmes techniques.

• Qualifications pour le rôle
  • Maîtrise en informatique, en TI, en génie ou dans une discipline connexe
  • 10+ ans en gestion de la technologie numérique avec expérience dans la définition de feuilles de route technologiques et de portefeuilles de développement complexes
  • Bonne expérience dans la conduite du processus de développement, des exigences au lancement de produits. Maîtrise des méthodologies Agiles et de l'expérience du modèle Gate ou d'un processus équivalent
  • Connaissance solide des plates-formes nuageuses (Azure préférée) et de l'architecture du système
  • Compréhension des technologies IoT, de l'informatique de bord et de l'automatisation industrielle
  • Capacité d'influencer sans autorité les organisations matricielles et de travailler à travers les pays et les cultures
  • Capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
    • Excellentes capacités de gestion de projets et de programmes
  • Capacités de communication et de gestion des intervenants. Fluent en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé
  • La disponibilité pour voyager est requise, selon les estimations, jusqu'à 20 % de voyages



Plus sur nous

La Division Service d'ABB s'associe à nos clients pour améliorer la disponibilité, la fiabilité, la prévisibilité et la durabilité des produits et installations électriques. Le vaste portefeuille de services de la Division offre des services de soins, de modernisation et de conseil pour améliorer les performances, prolonger la durée de vie du matériel et assurer de nouveaux niveaux d'efficacité opérationnelle et durable. Nous aidons les clients à garder les ressources en service aussi longtemps que possible, à en extraire la valeur maximale, puis à récupérer et à régénérer des produits et des matériaux à la fin de leur vie utile.
Rejoignez-nous. Faites partie de l'équipe où le progrès se produit, les industries se transforment, et votre travail façonne le monde. Lancer What Runs the World.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

Your Role

In this dynamic sales position, you will drive market development with switchgear manufacturers across the North-West region of German-speaking Switzerland. You will identify market opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and successfully position our electrical power distribution solutions. Working collaboratively with internal teams, channel partners, and stakeholders, you'll contribute directly to sustainable business growth.

Work Model: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales targets by identifying new market opportunities, building a sustainable sales pipeline in Salesforce, and developing targeted business strategies

  • Guide customer projects from opportunity to completion, creating tailored technical and commercial solutions with internal teams and partners

  • Cultivate long-term partnerships by identifying customer needs, providing expert consulting, and delivering excellent service throughout the sales cycle

  • Coordinate all stakeholders and manage professional sales processes, ensuring accurate communication on delivery times, terms, and contractual conditions

• Qualifications

  • Several years of successful experience in technical or project sales, ideally in switchgear, power distribution, or building technology with proven track record

  • Technical background with relevant training or studies in electrical engineering and power distribution

  • Ability to navigate complex sales processes and communicate effectively with decision-makers at all levels

  • Demonstrated strength in building sustainable client relationships with a partnership-focused approach

  • Strategic consulting expertise on business models, market positioning, and differentiation

  • Structured, solution-oriented approach with strong prioritization and adaptability in dynamic environments

  • Collaborative team player with professional communication skills and cross-departmental mindset

  • Language skills: Native German speaker, any additional language is a plus

  • Valid Category B driving license and a valid Swiss work permit

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Company Car

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings optimizes energy efficiency, safety, security, and comfort across all building types through innovative digital technologies and integrated solutions. We serve diverse markets—from single-family homes to industrial applications—with scalable solutions that deliver sustainable and financial benefits while supporting carbon reduction strategies.

This recruiting process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Service Sales Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop service sales, from lead generation, service sales opportunities creation until securing the profitable sales within the designated areas. Each day, you will focus on Installed Base (IB) and sell the entire Service portfolio. You will also showcase your skills by building long-term customer relationships and ensuring immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This role contributes to the Service of Mining and Materials Business Line within the Automation Process Industries division in a defined global region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Penetrating into IB, promoting various upgrades, retrofits, and value-add services to the benefit of the customers and ABB.
  • Understanding the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices, preparing sales plans, reviewing them, and proposing recovery plan(s) when needed.
  • Generating service sales leads and developing new market opportunities by utilizing market trend information and through identifying and exploring potential new service portfolios.
  • Acting as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s service products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).


Our team dynamics
You will join an international collaborative team working in a changing business environment, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Engineering Disciplines, Business Administration or similar and 5+ years of experience in the mining business. Experience in service sales or similar roles is very beneficial
  • You are highly motivated and enjoy working in agile market and you’re willing to travel up to 30% worldwide
  • Demonstrated experience in managing global accounts, increasing sales growth, and complex negotiations
  • Solid stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and customers
  • Solid data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC)
  • Experience with digital sales enablement, customer demonstrations, and lifecycle-service offerings are advantages.
  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership up to complex, high-value solution deals
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and German

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Learning and growth opportunities
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Generous vacation allowance


More about us
We help the mining industry become safer, leaner, and more sustainable by combining electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience.
Our comprehensive mining services portfolio - ranging from engineering and maintenance to digital and lifecycle solutions - supports customers in maximizing asset performance and availability.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop service sales, from lead generation, service sales opportunities creation until securing the profitable sales within the designated areas. Each day, you will focus on Installed Base (IB) and sell the entire Service portfolio. You will also showcase your skills by building long-term customer relationships and ensuring immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This role contributes to the Service of Mining and Materials Business Line within the Automation Process Industries division in a defined global region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Penetrating into IB, promoting various upgrades, retrofits, and value-add services to the benefit of the customers and ABB.
  • Understanding the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices, preparing sales plans, reviewing them, and proposing recovery plan(s) when needed.
  • Generating service sales leads and developing new market opportunities by utilizing market trend information and through identifying and exploring potential new service portfolios.
  • Acting as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s service products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).


Our team dynamics
You will join an international collaborative team working in a changing business environment, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Engineering Disciplines, Business Administration or similar and 5+ years of experience in the mining business. Experience in service sales or similar roles is very beneficial
  • You are highly motivated and enjoy working in agile market and you’re willing to travel up to 30% worldwide
  • Demonstrated experience in managing global accounts, increasing sales growth, and complex negotiations
  • Solid stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and customers
  • Solid data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC)
  • Experience with digital sales enablement, customer demonstrations, and lifecycle-service offerings are advantages.
  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership up to complex, high-value solution deals
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and German

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Learning and growth opportunities
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Generous vacation allowance


More about us
We help the mining industry become safer, leaner, and more sustainable by combining electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience.
Our comprehensive mining services portfolio - ranging from engineering and maintenance to digital and lifecycle solutions - supports customers in maximizing asset performance and availability.
Together with our customers, we deliver tailored, data-driven solutions that enable reliable operations today while shaping the future of the all-electric, connected mine.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer with a strong background in power electronics and proven experience in the design and validation of Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS). The Product Quality Engineer plays a pivotal role in collaborating with the R&D department for product design and implementation.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Acting as a quality interface between Agile Teams (R&D & Product Management), Operations, and Suppliers to ensure product robustness before the release (G5).

  • Furthermore you will be analyzing test data, quality KPIs, and field return issues and providing critical feedback during the definition of product requirements, influencing design for quality and reliability.

  • Managing quality product validation, according to ABB PCP (Product Creation Process) or equivalent methodologies (e.g., APQP), including test planning, design, and execution.

  • Actively supporting the Design FMEA, Process FMEA, and PPAP activities in cross-functional teams. Additionally, you will contribute to improving Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Testing (DFT), with a focus on PCBA production processes.


You will join a dynamic, talented and high-performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor's Degree in Electronic Engineering.

  • Previous experience in product development as well as 5+ years of experience in the Power Electronics industry, preferably in the UPS sector.

  • Strong expertise in UPS architecture (single-phase and three-phase systems from 10 kW to 2 MW), including both hardware and software is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with product validation plans, including definition, execution, and analysis of lab test results.

  • Solid knowledge of FMEA, PPAP, PCP/APQP quality tools and methodologies is desired.

  • Deep understanding of PCBA manufacturing processes, including the ability to influence design for testing and manufacturability.

  • Fluent or professional-level English (both spoken and written) with strong team spirit and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

More about us


ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Gestionnaire de la qualité

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de la qualité des produits avec une solide expérience en électronique de puissance et une expérience éprouvée dans la conception et la validation des alimentations non interruptibles (UPS). L'ingénieur de la qualité des produits joue un rôle central dans la collaboration avec le département de la R-D pour la conception et la mise en oeuvre des produits.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Ce rôle contribue à la division Puissance critique, Puissance intelligente à Quartino, Suisse.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • En agissant comme interface de qualité entre les équipes agiles (gestion de la R-D et des produits), les opérations et les fournisseurs pour assurer la robustesse du produit avant la publication (G5).

  • De plus, vous analyserez les données d'essai, les ICR de qualité et les questions de retour sur le terrain et fournirez une rétroaction critique pendant la définition des exigences du produit, influençant la conception de la qualité et de la fiabilité.

  • Gestion de la validation du produit de qualité, selon le processus de création de produits ABB (processus de création de produits) ou des méthodologies équivalentes (p. ex., PAQA), y compris la planification, la conception et l'exécution des essais.

  • Soutenir activement les activités de conception FMEA, de processus FMEA et de PPAP dans les équipes interfonctionnelles. De plus, vous contribuerez à améliorer la conception pour la fabrication (DFM) et la conception pour les essais (DFT), en mettant l'accent sur les processus de production des BPCA.


Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique, talentueuse et performante, où vous pourrez prospérer.


• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en génie électronique.

  • Expérience antérieure dans le développement de produits ainsi que 5+ ans d'expérience dans l'industrie de l'électronique électrique, de préférence dans le secteur de l'UPS.

  • Expérience solide en architecture de l'UPS (systèmes monophasés et triphasés de 10 kW à 2 MW), y compris le matériel et les logiciels est préféré.

  • Expérience pratique des plans de validation des produits, y compris la définition, l'exécution et l'analyse des résultats des essais en laboratoire.

  • Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes et des outils de qualité du FMEA, du PPAP, du PCP/APQP est souhaitée.

  • Une compréhension approfondie des processus de fabrication de PCPA, y compris la capacité d'influencer la conception pour les essais et la fabrication.

  • En anglais souple ou professionnel (à la fois parlé et écrit) avec un esprit d'équipe solide et la capacité de travailler sous pression dans un environnement à rythme rapide

Plus sur nous


ABB Smart Power est un chef de file mondial de la technologie, avec des produits et des solutions qui rendent les approvisionnements électriques intelligents, connectés et protégés. Ses produits et solutions intelligents rendent la puissance plus compétitive en améliorant l'efficacité énergétique, la productivité et la fiabilité de presque toutes les opérations. This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

As an R&D Senior Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.
  • Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.
  • Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.
  • Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than five years of professional experience in electrical engineering.
  • Must have experience working with power electronic systems
  • Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.
  • Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.
  • Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.
  • Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.
